translations.literal: At that time Li Huaiguang rebelled and held the middle of the river.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Li Huaiguang rebelled and held the middle of the river.

sentences.zh: 李希烈已陷大梁，南逼江、漢；

translations.literal: Li Xilie had already fallen Daliang and pressed south on the Jiang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xilie had already fallen Daliang and pressed south on the Jiang and Han.

sentences.zh: 李納尚反於齊，田緒未為用；

translations.literal: Li Na still rebelled in Qi; Tian Xu had not yet been put to use.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na still rebelled in Qi. Tian Xu had not yet been put to use.

sentences.zh: 李晟孤軍壁渭上。

translations.literal: Li Sheng's lone army walled on the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng's lone army walled on the Wei.

sentences.zh: 天子羽書所制者，天下才十二三，海內蕩析，人心失歸。

translations.literal: Of the realm the emperor's urgent dispatches could reach, only twelve or thirteen tenths remained; within the seas all was shaken apart and hearts lost their mooring.
translations.idiomatic: Of the realm the emperor's urgent dispatches could reach, only twelve or thirteen tenths remained. Within the seas all was shaken apart and hearts lost their mooring.

sentences.zh: 賈林又說武俊與抱真合軍，同救魏博，為武俊陳利害曰：「硃滔此行，欲先平魏博，更逢田悅被害，人心不安。

translations.literal: Jia Lin again persuaded Wujun and Baozhen to join armies and together rescue Weibo; for Wujun he set forth advantage and harm: "Zhu Tao on this campaign wishes first to pacify Weibo; moreover Tian Yue has been harmed and hearts are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Lin again persuaded Wujun and Baozhen to join armies and together rescue Weibo. For Wujun he set forth advantage and harm: "Zhu Tao on this campaign wishes first to pacify Weibo. Moreover Tian Yue has been harmed and hearts are unsettled.

sentences.zh: 旬日不救，魏、貝必下，滔益數萬。

translations.literal: If not rescued within ten days, Wei and Bei will fall and Tao will gain tens of thousands more.
translations.idiomatic: If not rescued within ten days, Wei and Bei will fall and Tao will gain tens of thousands more.

sentences.zh: 張孝忠見魏、貝已拔，必臣硃滔。

translations.literal: When Zhang Xiaozhong sees Wei and Bei already taken, he is sure to become Zhu Tao's minister.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xiaozhong sees Wei and Bei already taken, he is sure to become Zhu Tao's minister.

sentences.zh: 三道連衡，兼統回紇，長驅至此，家族可得免乎？

translations.literal: Three circuits in alliance, also commanding the Uyghur, charging here at full speed—can your clan escape?
translations.idiomatic: Three circuits in alliance, also commanding the Uyghur, charging here at full speed—can your clan escape?

sentences.zh: 常山不守，則昭義退保山西，河朔地盡入滔。

translations.literal: If Changshan is not held, Zhaoyi retreats to guard Shanxi and all Hebei lands fall to Tao.
translations.idiomatic: If Changshan is not held, Zhaoyi retreats to guard Shanxi and all Hebei lands fall to Tao.

sentences.zh: 今乘魏、貝未下，孝忠未附，公與昭義合軍破之，如掇遺耳！

translations.literal: Now while Wei and Bei are not yet fallen and Xiaozhong not yet attached, if you and Zhaoyi join armies and break them, it is like picking up what lies before you!
translations.idiomatic: Now while Wei and Bei are not yet fallen and Xiaozhong not yet attached, if you and Zhaoyi join armies and break them, it is like picking up what lies before you!

sentences.zh: 此計就，則聲振關中，京邑可坐復，鑾輿反正自公，則勛業無二也。」

translations.literal: Once this plan succeeds, fame will shake Guanzhong, the capital can be recovered at a sitting, and the imperial carriage returns to correctness through you—then merit will be second to none."
translations.idiomatic: Once this plan succeeds, fame will shake Guanzhong, the capital can be recovered at a sitting, and the imperial carriage returns to correctness through you—then merit will be second to none."

sentences.zh: 武俊歡然許之。

translations.literal: Wujun gladly agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun gladly agreed.

sentences.zh: 兩軍議定，卜日同征。

translations.literal: The two armies settled the plan and chose a day to campaign together.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies settled the plan and chose a day to campaign together.

sentences.zh: 五月，武俊、抱真會軍於鉅鹿東。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Wujun and Baozhen joined armies east of Julu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wujun and Baozhen joined armies east of Julu.

sentences.zh: 兩軍既交，滔震恐。

translations.literal: Once the two armies engaged, Tao was shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Once the two armies engaged, Tao was shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 抱真為方陣，武俊用奇兵，硃滔傾壘出戰。

translations.literal: Baozhen formed a square array; Wujun used irregular troops; Zhu Tao brought out his whole camp to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Baozhen formed a square array; Wujun used irregular troops. Zhu Tao brought out his whole camp to fight.

sentences.zh: 武俊不擐甲而馳之。

translations.literal: Wujun charged without donning armor.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun charged without donning armor.

sentences.zh: 滔望風奔潰，自相蹂踐，死者十四五。

translations.literal: Tao fled at the sight of the wind, trampling one another; fourteen or fifteen tenths died.
translations.idiomatic: Tao fled at the sight of the wind, trampling one another. Fourteen or fifteen tenths died.

sentences.zh: 收其輜重、器甲、馬牛不可勝計，滔夜奔還幽州。

translations.literal: They seized baggage, arms, cattle, and horses beyond counting; Tao fled by night back to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They seized baggage, arms, cattle, and horses beyond counting. Tao fled by night back to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 武俊班師，表讓幽州盧龍節度使，許之。

translations.literal: Wujun withdrew his army and in a memorial yielded the Youzhou Lulong commissionership; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun withdrew his army and in a memorial yielded the Youzhou Lulong commissionership; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 乃升恆州為大都督府，以武俊為長史，加檢校司徒，實封七百戶，余如故。

translations.literal: Hengzhou was then elevated to a great metropolitan prefecture; Wujun was made chief administrator, further made Acting Minister of War, with a substantive fief of seven hundred households; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou was then elevated to a great metropolitan prefecture. Wujun was made chief administrator, further made Acting Minister of War, with a substantive fief of seven hundred households; the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 車駕還京，寵之逾厚。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, favor toward him grew ever thicker.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, favor toward him grew ever thicker.

sentences.zh: 子尚貴主，子弟在孩稚者，皆賜官名。

translations.literal: His son married the Noble Princess; children still in infancy all received official names.
translations.idiomatic: His son married the Noble Princess; children still in infancy all received official names.

sentences.zh: 尋丁母憂，起復加左金吾上將軍同正；

translations.literal: Soon he entered mourning for his mother and was recalled to office as Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered mourning for his mother and was recalled to office as Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank.

sentences.zh: 免喪，加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was further made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the privilege of opening an office.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was further made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the privilege of opening an office.

sentences.zh: 十二年，上念舊勛，加檢校太尉，兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor, mindful of old merit, further made him Acting Grand Marshal and Concurrent Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor, mindful of old merit, further made him Acting Grand Marshal and Concurrent Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月卒，時年六十七，廢朝五日，群臣詣延英門奉慰，如渾瑊故事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year he died at sixty-seven; court was suspended five days; ministers went to the Yanying Gate to offer condolences, following Hun Jian's precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year he died at sixty-seven. Court was suspended five days; ministers went to the Yanying Gate to offer condolences, following Hun Jian's precedent.

sentences.zh: 詔左庶子上公持節冊贈太師，賻絹三千匹、布千端、米粟三千碩。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Left Assistant to the Heir Apparent, a duke of the first rank, to bear credentials and posthumously enfeoff him as Grand Preceptor, with three thousand rolls of silk, a thousand rolls of cloth, and three thousand piculs of grain and millet as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Left Assistant to the Heir Apparent, a duke of the first rank, to bear credentials and posthumously enfeoff him as Grand Preceptor, with three thousand rolls of silk, a thousand rolls of cloth, and three thousand piculs of grain and millet as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 太常謚曰威烈，德宗曰：「武俊竭忠奉國，宜賜謚忠烈。」

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies proposed the posthumous title Weilie; Emperor Dezong said: "Wujun exhausted loyalty in serving the state—he should be given the posthumous title Zhonglie."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies proposed the posthumous title Weilie. Emperor Dezong said, "Wujun exhausted loyalty in serving the state—he should be given the posthumous title Zhonglie."

sentences.zh: 子士真、士清、士平、士則。

translations.literal: His sons were Shizhen, Shiqing, Shiping, and Shize.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Shizhen, Shiqing, Shiping, and Shize.

sentences.zh: 士真嗣。

translations.literal: Shizhen succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen succeeded.

sentences.zh: 士真，武俊長子。

translations.literal: Shizhen was Wujun's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen was Wujun's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 少驍悍，冠於軍中，沈謀有斷。

translations.literal: From youth he was fierce and bold, foremost in the army; he had deep strategy and decisive judgment.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was fierce and bold, foremost in the army. He had deep strategy and decisive judgment.

sentences.zh: 事李寶臣為帳中親將，仍以女妻之。

translations.literal: Serving Li Baochen as a close general in headquarters, he also married Baochen's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Li Baochen as a close general in headquarters, he also married Baochen's daughter.

sentences.zh: 寶臣末年，慮身後諸子暗弱，為諸將所奪，屢行誅戮，諸將離心。

translations.literal: In Baochen's later years, fearing that after his death his sons would be dim and weak and be seized by the generals, he repeatedly carried out executions; the generals turned away in heart.
translations.idiomatic: In Baochen's later years, fearing that after his death his sons would be dim and weak and be seized by the generals, he repeatedly carried out executions. The generals turned away in heart.

sentences.zh: 武俊官位雖卑，而勇略邁世；

translations.literal: Though Wujun's office was low, his courage and strategy surpassed the age.
translations.idiomatic: Though Wujun's office was low, his courage and strategy surpassed the age.

sentences.zh: 寶臣惜其才，不忍誅之。

translations.literal: Baochen cherished his talent and could not bear to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen cherished his talent and could not bear to kill him.

sentences.zh: 而士真密結寶臣左右，保護其父，以是獲免。

translations.literal: Shizhen secretly joined with those around Baochen and protected his father, and thereby escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen secretly joined with those around Baochen and protected his father, and thereby escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 惟嶽之世，尤加委任，武俊亦盡心匡佐。

translations.literal: In Weiyue's time he was especially entrusted; Wujun also gave his whole heart in support.
translations.idiomatic: In Weiyue's time he was especially entrusted. Wujun also gave his whole heart in support.

sentences.zh: 既兵敗束鹿，張孝忠、康日知以地歸國，受官賞；

translations.literal: After defeat at Shulu, Zhang Xiaozhong and Kang Rizhi submitted their lands to the state and received offices and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: After defeat at Shulu, Zhang Xiaozhong and Kang Rizhi submitted their lands to the state and received offices and rewards.

sentences.zh: 惟嶽稍貯防疑，武俊謀自貶損，出入不過三兩人。

translations.literal: Weiyue gradually stored suspicion; Wujun planned self-abasement and when going out took no more than two or three men.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyue gradually stored suspicion. Wujun planned self-abasement and when going out took no more than two or three men.

sentences.zh: 左右謂惟嶽曰：「先相公委任武俊，以遺大夫，兼有治命。

translations.literal: Those around said to Weiyue: "The former lord entrusted Wujun to leave to the lord, and there was also a deathbed command.
translations.idiomatic: Those around said to Weiyue, "The former lord entrusted Wujun to leave to the lord, and there was also a deathbed command.

sentences.zh: 今披肝膽為大夫者，武俊耳。

translations.literal: Now the one who lays bare his liver and heart for the lord is Wujun alone.
translations.idiomatic: Now the one who lays bare his liver and heart for the lord is Wujun alone.

sentences.zh: 又士真即大夫妹婿，保無異志。

translations.literal: Moreover Shizhen is the lord's brother-in-law—surely he harbors no disloyal intent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Shizhen is the lord's brother-in-law—surely he harbors no disloyal intent.

sentences.zh: 今勢危急，若不坦懷待之，若更如康日知，即大事去矣！」

translations.literal: Now the situation is critically urgent—if you do not treat him with open heart, and he becomes another Kang Rizhi, the great affair is lost!"
translations.idiomatic: Now the situation is critically urgent—if you do not treat him with open heart, and he becomes another Kang Rizhi, the great affair is lost!"

sentences.zh: 惟嶽曰：「我待武俊自厚，不獨先公遺旨。」

translations.literal: Weiyue said: "I treat Wujun generously on my own—not only because of the former lord's last command."
translations.idiomatic: Weiyue said, "I treat Wujun generously on my own—not only because of the former lord's last command."

sentences.zh: 由是無疑，即令將兵攻趙州。

translations.literal: From this there was no suspicion; he then ordered him to lead troops to attack Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: From this there was no suspicion. He then ordered him to lead troops to attack Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 士真更宿於府衙，與同職謀事。

translations.literal: Shizhen lodged overnight in the government office and plotted with colleagues of the same office.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen lodged overnight in the government office and plotted with colleagues of the same office.

sentences.zh: 及武俊倒戈，士真等數人擒惟嶽出衙，縊死之。

translations.literal: When Wujun turned his swords, Shizhen and several others seized Weiyue and brought him out of the yamen and strangled him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wujun turned his swords, Shizhen and several others seized Weiyue and brought him out of the yamen and strangled him.

sentences.zh: 武俊領節鉞，以士真為副大使。

translations.literal: Wujun took the commissioner's baton and made Shizhen deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun took the commissioner's baton and made Shizhen deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 建中年，武俊僭稱趙王於魏縣，以士真為司空、真定府留守，充元帥。

translations.literal: In the Jianzhong years Wujun presumptuously styled himself King of Zhao at Wei County and made Shizhen Minister of Works, Zhending capital intendant, and supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianzhong years Wujun presumptuously styled himself King of Zhao at Wei County and made Shizhen Minister of Works, Zhending capital intendant, and supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 及武俊破硃滔順命，以武俊兼幽州盧龍軍節度使，仍以士真為副使、檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: When Wujun defeated Zhu Tao and obeyed orders, Wujun was made concurrent military commissioner of Youzhou and Lulong, and Shizhen was still made deputy commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Wujun defeated Zhu Tao and obeyed orders, Wujun was made concurrent military commissioner of Youzhou and Lulong, and Shizhen was still made deputy commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 德宗還京，進位檢校兵部尚書，充德州刺史、德棣觀察使，封清河郡王。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong returned to the capital, he was promoted to Acting Minister of War, made prefect of Dezhou and commissioner of De and Di, and enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong returned to the capital, he was promoted to Acting Minister of War, made prefect of Dezhou and commissioner of De and Di, and enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 十七年，武俊卒，起復授左金吾衛大將軍同正、恆州大都督府長史，充成德軍節度、恆冀深趙德棣等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Wujun died; recalled from mourning he was appointed Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank, chief administrator of the Hengzhou metropolitan prefecture, and military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Heng, Ji, Shen, Zhao, De, and Di and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Wujun died. Recalled from mourning he was appointed Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank, chief administrator of the Hengzhou metropolitan prefecture, and military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Heng, Ji, Shen, Zhao, De, and Di and the like.

sentences.zh: 尋檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Soon he was Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 順宗即位，進位檢校司空。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shunzong took the throne, he was promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shunzong took the throne, he was promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 士真佐父立功，備歷艱苦；

translations.literal: Shizhen aided his father in establishing merit and passed through every hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen aided his father in establishing merit and passed through every hardship.

sentences.zh: 得位之後，恬然守善，雖自補屬吏，賦不上供，然歲貢貨財，名為進奉者，亦數十萬，比幽、魏二鎮，最為承順。

translations.literal: After gaining position he calmly kept to what was good; though he appointed his own subordinate officials and did not remit taxes, yet each year he presented goods and wealth under the name of tribute offerings—also several hundred thousand—and among You and Wei he was the most deferential.
translations.idiomatic: After gaining position he calmly kept to what was good. Though he appointed his own subordinate officials and did not remit taxes, yet each year he presented goods and wealth under the name of tribute offerings—also several hundred thousand—and among You and Wei he was the most deferential.

sentences.zh: 元和元年，就加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanhe he was further made Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanhe he was further made Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四年三月卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he died.

sentences.zh: 子承宗、承元、承通、承迪、承榮。

translations.literal: His sons were Chengzong, Chengyuan, Chengtong, Chendi, and Chengrong.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Chengzong, Chengyuan, Chengtong, Chendi, and Chengrong.

sentences.zh: 士清，以父勛累加官至殿中少監同正。

translations.literal: Shiqing, through his father's merit, was repeatedly promoted to Palace Vice Director of the same rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing, through his father's merit, was repeatedly promoted to Palace Vice Director of the same rank.

sentences.zh: 元和初，為冀州刺史、御史大夫，封北海郡王，早卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanhe he was prefect of Ji Prefecture and Censor-in-Chief, enfeoffed as Prince of Beihai, and died early.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanhe he was prefect of Ji Prefecture and Censor-in-Chief, enfeoffed as Prince of Beihai, and died early.

sentences.zh: 士平，以父勛補原王府咨議。

translations.literal: Shiping, through his father's merit, was appointed counselor to the Prince of Yuan's household.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping, through his father's merit, was appointed counselor to the Prince of Yuan's household.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，選尚義陽公主，加秘書少監同正、附馬都尉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan he was selected to marry Princess Yiyang and was made Acting Vice Director of the Secretariat of the same rank and Commandant of the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyuan he was selected to marry Princess Yiyang and was made Acting Vice Director of the Secretariat of the same rank and Commandant of the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 元和中，累遷至安州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe years he was repeatedly promoted to prefect of An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe years he was repeatedly promoted to prefect of An Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時公主縱恣不法，士平與之爭忿；

translations.literal: At that time the princess was wanton and lawless; Shiping quarreled with her in anger.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the princess was wanton and lawless. Shiping quarreled with her in anger.

sentences.zh: 憲宗怒，幽公主於禁中，士平幽於私第，不令出入。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong was angry, confined the princess within the inner palace, and confined Shiping in his private residence, not allowing him to go out.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong was angry, confined the princess within the inner palace, and confined Shiping in his private residence, not allowing him to go out.

sentences.zh: 後釋之，出為安州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was released and went out as prefect of An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was released and went out as prefect of An Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 坐與中貴交結，貶賀州司戶。

translations.literal: For associating with inner attendants he was demoted to Registrar of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: For associating with inner attendants he was demoted to Registrar of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時輕薄文士蔡南、獨孤申叔為義陽主歌詞，曰《團雪》、《散雪》等曲，言其遊處離異之狀，往往歌於酒席。

translations.literal: At that time frivolous literati Cai Nan and Dugu Shenshu wrote song lyrics for Princess Yiyang, such as "Ball of Snow" and "Scattered Snow," describing her roaming and separation; they were often sung at banquets.
translations.idiomatic: At that time frivolous literati Cai Nan and Dugu Shenshu wrote song lyrics for Princess Yiyang, such as "Ball of Snow" and "Scattered Snow," describing her roaming and separation. They were often sung at banquets.

sentences.zh: 憲宗聞而惡之，欲廢進士科，令所司網捉搦，得南、申叔貶之，由是稍止。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong heard and hated it; he wished to abolish the jinshi examination and ordered the authorities to hunt and seize them; Nan and Shenshu were demoted, and from this it gradually stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong heard and hated it. He wished to abolish the jinshi examination and ordered the authorities to hunt and seize them. Nan and Shenshu were demoted, and from this it gradually stopped.

sentences.zh: 及盜殺宰相武元衡，旬日捕賊未獲。

translations.literal: When assassins killed Chancellor Wu Yuanheng, for ten days the robbers were not captured.
translations.idiomatic: When assassins killed Chancellor Wu Yuanheng, for ten days the robbers were not captured.

sentences.zh: 士平與兄士則庭奏盜主於承宗，既獲張晏等誅之，乃以士平為左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Shiping with his elder brother Shize memorialized at court that the assassins were directed by Chengzong; after Zhang Yan and the like were captured and executed, Shiping was made Great General of the Left Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping with his elder brother Shize memorialized at court that the assassins were directed by Chengzong. After Zhang Yan and the like were captured and executed, Shiping was made Great General of the Left Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 及奪承宗官爵，仍以士平襲父實封。

translations.literal: When Chengzong's offices and titles were stripped, Shiping still inherited his father's substantive fief.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong's offices and titles were stripped, Shiping still inherited his father's substantive fief.

sentences.zh: 士則，士平異母兄。

translations.literal: Shize was Shiping's elder half-brother.
translations.idiomatic: Shize was Shiping's elder half-brother.

sentences.zh: 承宗既立為節度使，不容諸父，乃奔於京師，用為神策大將軍。

translations.literal: After Chengzong was established as military commissioner he would not tolerate his uncles; Shize fled to the capital and was used as a great general of the Shence Army.
translations.idiomatic: After Chengzong was established as military commissioner he would not tolerate his uncles. Shize fled to the capital and was used as a great general of the Shence Army.

sentences.zh: 及承宗叛逆，盜殺宰相，士則請移貫京兆府。

translations.literal: When Chengzong rebelled and assassins killed the chancellor, Shize asked to transfer his household registration to the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong rebelled and assassins killed the chancellor, Shize asked to transfer his household registration to the capital district.

sentences.zh: 諸鎮兵討承宗，裴度言士則武俊子，其軍中必有懷之者，乃用士則為邢州刺史，兼本州團練使，從昭義節度使郗士美討賊，冀攜離承宗之黨，且許以節制。

translations.literal: The commanderies' armies attacked Chengzong; Pei Du said Shize was Wujun's son and that within his army there were sure to be those who harbored sympathy for him; Shize was then used as prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrent regimental commander of that prefecture, following Zhaoyi military commissioner Xi Shimei in attacking the rebels, hoping to divide Chengzong's faction, and he was also promised the commissioner's baton.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies' armies attacked Chengzong. Pei Du said Shize was Wujun's son and that within his army there were sure to be those who harbored sympathy for him. Shize was then used as prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrent regimental commander of that prefecture, following Zhaoyi military commissioner Xi Shimei in attacking the rebels, hoping to divide Chengzong's faction, and he was also promised the commissioner's baton.

sentences.zh: 士則恃此，頗不受士美節制，行止以兵自衛；

translations.literal: Shize relied on this and quite refused to obey Shimei's command; in movement and rest he guarded himself with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Shize relied on this and quite refused to obey Shimei's command. In movement and rest he guarded himself with troops.

sentences.zh: 雖謁士美，而衛兵如故。

translations.literal: Though he paid court to Shimei, his guards remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Though he paid court to Shimei, his guards remained as before.

sentences.zh: 吏呵止之，士則不能平，見於辭氣。

translations.literal: Clerks shouted to stop them; Shize could not be at peace and showed it in his words and manner.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks shouted to stop them. Shize could not be at peace and showed it in his words and manner.

sentences.zh: 士美惡之，密以狀聞，乃以張遵代還。

translations.literal: Shimei hated this and secretly reported the situation; Zhang Zun was then used to replace him and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Shimei hated this and secretly reported the situation. Zhang Zun was then used to replace him and he returned.

sentences.zh: 承宗，士真長子。

translations.literal: Chengzong was Shizhen's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was Shizhen's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 河朔三鎮自置副大使，以嫡長為之。

translations.literal: The three Hebei circuits each appointed their own deputy commissioners, with the legitimate eldest as holder.
translations.idiomatic: The three Hebei circuits each appointed their own deputy commissioners, with the legitimate eldest as holder.

sentences.zh: 承宗累奏至鎮州大都督府右司馬、知州事、御史大夫，充都知兵馬使、副大使。

translations.literal: Chengzong repeatedly memorialized up to Right Vice Administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, knowing prefectural affairs, Censor-in-Chief, concurrent commander of all military affairs, and deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong repeatedly memorialized up to Right Vice Administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, knowing prefectural affairs, Censor-in-Chief, concurrent commander of all military affairs, and deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 元和四年三月，士真卒；

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Yuanhe Shizhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Yuanhe Shizhen died.

sentences.zh: 三軍推為留後，朝廷伺其變，累月不問。

translations.literal: The three armies pushed him as acting commissioner; the court watched for change and for months did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The three armies pushed him as acting commissioner. The court watched for change and for months did not inquire.

sentences.zh: 承宗懼，累上表陳謝。

translations.literal: Chengzong was afraid and repeatedly submitted memorials of apology.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was afraid and repeatedly submitted memorials of apology.

sentences.zh: 至八月，上令京兆少尹裴武往宣諭，承宗奉詔甚恭，且曰：「三軍見迫，不候朝旨，今請割德、棣二州上獻，以表丹懇。」

translations.literal: By the eighth month the emperor ordered Capital Assistant Prefect Pei Wu to go proclaim the edict; Chengzong received the edict very deferentially and said: "The three armies forced me; I did not await the court's command. Now I ask to cede De and Di prefectures in submission to show sincere devotion."
translations.idiomatic: By the eighth month the emperor ordered Capital Assistant Prefect Pei Wu to go proclaim the edict. Chengzong received the edict very deferentially and said, "The three armies forced me. I did not await the court's command. Now I ask to cede De and Di prefectures in submission to show sincere devotion."

sentences.zh: 由是起復雲麾將軍、左金吾衛大將軍同正、檢校工部尚書、鎮州大都督府長史、御史大夫、成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was recalled from mourning as Cloud Banner General, Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank, Acting Vice Minister of Works, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was recalled from mourning as Cloud Banner General, Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank, Acting Vice Minister of Works, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao and the like.

sentences.zh: 又以德州刺史薛昌朝檢校右散騎常侍、德州刺史、御史大夫，充保信軍節度、德棣觀察等使。

translations.literal: Also De Prefecture prefect Xue Changchao was made Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, prefect of De Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Baoxin Army and commissioner of De and Di and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Also De Prefecture prefect Xue Changchao was made Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, prefect of De Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Baoxin Army and commissioner of De and Di and the like.

sentences.zh: 昌朝，故昭義節度使嵩之子，婚姻於王氏，入仕於成德軍，故為刺史。

translations.literal: Changchao was the son of the former Zhaoyi military commissioner Song; allied by marriage with the Wang clan, he entered service in the Chengde Army and therefore became prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Changchao was the son of the former Zhaoyi military commissioner Song. Allied by marriage with the Wang clan, he entered service in the Chengde Army and therefore became prefect.

sentences.zh: 承宗既獻二州，朝廷不欲別命將帥，且授其親將。

translations.literal: After Chengzong had offered the two prefectures, the court did not wish to appoint another commander and gave the commission to his close general.
translations.idiomatic: After Chengzong had offered the two prefectures, the court did not wish to appoint another commander and gave the commission to his close general.

sentences.zh: 保信旌節未至德州，承宗遣數百騎馳往德州，虜昌朝歸真定囚之。

translations.literal: Before the Baoxin banner and baton reached De Prefecture, Chengzong sent several hundred horsemen galloping to De Prefecture, seized Changchao, and brought him back to Zhending as a prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Baoxin banner and baton reached De Prefecture, Chengzong sent several hundred horsemen galloping to De Prefecture, seized Changchao, and brought him back to Zhending as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 朝廷又加棣州刺史田渙充本州團練守捉使，冀漸離之。

translations.literal: The court also made Di Prefecture prefect Tian Huan concurrent regimental commander and defense commissioner of that prefecture, hoping gradually to separate them.
translations.idiomatic: The court also made Di Prefecture prefect Tian Huan concurrent regimental commander and defense commissioner of that prefecture, hoping gradually to separate them.

sentences.zh: 令中使景忠信往諭旨，令遣昌朝還鎮，承宗不奉詔。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the inner attendant Jing Zhongxin to go proclaim the intent and order the return of Changchao to his post; Chengzong would not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the inner attendant Jing Zhongxin to go proclaim the intent and order the return of Changchao to his post. Chengzong would not obey the edict.

sentences.zh: 憲宗怒，下詔曰：「枉承宗頃在苫廬，潛窺戎鎮；

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong was angry and issued an edict: "Wang Chengzong, while lately in mourning garb, secretly watched the military post.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong was angry and issued an edict: "Wang Chengzong, while lately in mourning garb, secretly watched the military post.

sentences.zh: 而內外以事君之禮，逆而必誅，分土之儀，專則有辟。

translations.literal: Yet inwardly and outwardly, by the ritual of serving the ruler, rebellion must be punished; by the ceremony of dividing territory, usurpation has its law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet inwardly and outwardly, by the ritual of serving the ruler, rebellion must be punished; by the ceremony of dividing territory, usurpation has its law.

sentences.zh: 朕念其先祖嘗有茂勛，貸以私恩，抑於公議。

translations.literal: I, mindful that his ancestors once had abundant merit, pardoned him for private feeling and restrained him for public discussion.
translations.idiomatic: I, mindful that his ancestors once had abundant merit, pardoned him for private feeling and restrained him for public discussion.

sentences.zh: 使臣旁午以告諭，孽童俯伏以陳誠，願獻兩州，期無二事。

translations.literal: Envoys came one after another with admonition; the young man bowed low and declared sincerity, promising to offer two prefectures and swearing no second intent.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came one after another with admonition. The young man bowed low and declared sincerity, promising to offer two prefectures and swearing no second intent.

sentences.zh: 朕欲收其後效，用以曲全，授節制於舊疆，齒勛賢於列位。

translations.literal: I wished to harvest his later merit and thereby bend to preserve him whole, granting commission over the old territory and ranking him among meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: I wished to harvest his later merit and thereby bend to preserve him whole, granting commission over the old territory and ranking him among meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 況德、棣本非成德所管，昌朝又是承宗懿親，俾撫近鄰，斯誠厚渥，外雖兩鎮，中實一家。

translations.literal: Moreover De and Di were never under Chengde's jurisdiction; Changchao is also Chengzong's close kin—to comfort a neighboring circuit is truly generous favor; outwardly two commands, inwardly one household.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover De and Di were never under Chengde's jurisdiction. Changchao is also Chengzong's close kin—to comfort a neighboring circuit is truly generous favor. Outwardly two commands, inwardly one household.

sentences.zh: 而承宗象恭懷奸，肖貌稔禍。

translations.literal: Yet Chengzong outwardly showed respect while inwardly harbored treachery; his face mirrored accumulated disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Chengzong outwardly showed respect while inwardly harbored treachery; his face mirrored accumulated disaster.

sentences.zh: 欺裴武於得位之後，縲昌朝於受命之中。

translations.literal: He deceived Pei Wu after gaining position and bound Changchao in the midst of receiving appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He deceived Pei Wu after gaining position and bound Changchao in the midst of receiving appointment.

sentences.zh: 豺狼之心，飽之而愈發；

translations.literal: The heart of a wolf and jackal, once fed, rages all the more.
translations.idiomatic: The heart of a wolf and jackal, once fed, rages all the more.

sentences.zh: 梟獍之性，養之而益兇。

translations.literal: The nature of an owl and jackal, once nurtured, grows ever more vicious.
translations.idiomatic: The nature of an owl and jackal, once nurtured, grows ever more vicious.

sentences.zh: 加以表疏之中，悖慢斯甚。

translations.literal: Moreover in his memorials insolence was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover in his memorials insolence was extreme.

sentences.zh: 式遏亂略，期於無刑；

translations.literal: To check disorder and plot, I look to punishment without execution.
translations.idiomatic: To check disorder and plot, I look to punishment without execution.

sentences.zh: 恭行天誅，幹於有制。

translations.literal: To reverently carry out heaven's punishment, action must have measure.
translations.idiomatic: To reverently carry out heaven's punishment, action must have measure.

sentences.zh: 可削承宗在身官爵。」

translations.literal: Chengzong's personal offices and titles are hereby stripped."
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong's personal offices and titles are hereby stripped."

sentences.zh: 詔左神策護軍中尉吐突承璀為左右神策、河中、河陽、浙西、宣歙等道赴鎮州行營兵馬招討處置等使，會諸道軍進討。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Left Shence Army Protector Tu Tu Chengcui as commander of the campaign army of the Left and Right Shence, Hezhong, Heyang, Zhexi, Xuanshe, and other circuits proceeding to Zhen Prefecture, recruiting and disposing troops, joining the armies of all circuits in advance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Left Shence Army Protector Tu Tu Chengcui as commander of the campaign army of the Left and Right Shence, Hezhong, Heyang, Zhexi, Xuanshe, and other circuits proceeding to Zhen Prefecture, recruiting and disposing troops, joining the armies of all circuits in advance.

sentences.zh: 神策兵馬使趙萬敵者，王武俊之騎將也，驍悍聞於燕、趙，具言進討必捷。

translations.literal: Shence army cavalry commander Zhao Wandi was Wang Wujun's cavalry general, famed for fierceness throughout Yan and Zhao, and declared that the advance would surely prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Shence army cavalry commander Zhao Wandi was Wang Wujun's cavalry general, famed for fierceness throughout Yan and Zhao, and declared that the advance would surely prevail.

sentences.zh: 承璀因得兵柄，與萬敵偕行。

translations.literal: Chengcui thereby gained military authority and marched together with Wandi.
translations.idiomatic: Chengcui thereby gained military authority and marched together with Wandi.

sentences.zh: 承璀至行營，威令不振，禁軍屢挫衄。

translations.literal: When Chengcui reached the campaign headquarters, authority and orders did not inspire; the inner guard army was repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengcui reached the campaign headquarters, authority and orders did not inspire. The inner guard army was repeatedly defeated.

sentences.zh: 都將酈定進前擒劉辟有功，號為驍將，又陷於賊。

translations.literal: Commander Li Dingjin had earlier captured Liu Pi with merit and was called a fierce general; he too fell into the rebels' hands.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Li Dingjin had earlier captured Liu Pi with merit and was called a fierce general. He too fell into the rebels' hands.

sentences.zh: 唯范陽節度使劉濟、易定節度使張茂昭至效忠赤，戰賊屢捷。

translations.literal: Only Fanyang military commissioner Liu Ji and Yiding military commissioner Zhang Maozhao came with utmost loyalty and fought the rebels with repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: Only Fanyang military commissioner Liu Ji and Yiding military commissioner Zhang Maozhao came with utmost loyalty and fought the rebels with repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 而昭義節度使盧從史反復難制，陰附於賊；

translations.literal: But Zhaoyi military commissioner Lu Congshi was changeable and hard to control and secretly attached to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: But Zhaoyi military commissioner Lu Congshi was changeable and hard to control and secretly attached to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 憲宗密詔承璀擒之，送於京師。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong secretly ordered Chengcui to seize him and send him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong secretly ordered Chengcui to seize him and send him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，承宗遣巡官崔遂上表三封，乞自陳首，且歸過於盧從史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year Chengzong sent touring officer Cui Sui with three sealed memorials begging to confess himself and attributing fault to Lu Congshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year Chengzong sent touring officer Cui Sui with three sealed memorials begging to confess himself and attributing fault to Lu Congshi.

sentences.zh: 其略曰：

translations.literal: The gist read:
translations.idiomatic: The gist read:

sentences.zh: 臣頃在苫廬，綿歷時序，恭守朝旨，罔敢闕違。

translations.literal: Your subject lately in mourning garb passed through seasons, reverently kept court commands, and dared not neglect or violate.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject lately in mourning garb passed through seasons, reverently kept court commands, and dared not neglect or violate.

sentences.zh: 復奉詔書，令獻州郡，迫以三軍之勢，不從孤臣之心。

translations.literal: Again I received the edict ordering the offering of prefectures; the three armies' force compelled me against this lone subject's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Again I received the edict ordering the offering of prefectures. The three armies' force compelled me against this lone subject's heart.

sentences.zh: 今天兵四臨，王命久絕，白刃之下，難避國刑；

translations.literal: Now the heavenly army presses on all sides; the royal command long cut off; under naked blades it is hard to escape national punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Now the heavenly army presses on all sides. The royal command long cut off. Under naked blades it is hard to escape national punishment.

sentences.zh: 殷憂之中，轉積釁隙。

translations.literal: In deep grief breaches accumulate ever more.
translations.idiomatic: In deep grief breaches accumulate ever more.

sentences.zh: 中由盧從史首為亂階，興天下之兵，生海內之亂，既不忠於國，又不孝於家。

translations.literal: The cause lies in Lu Congshi first making the ladder of disorder, raising troops throughout the realm and producing chaos within the seas—neither loyal to the state nor filial to his house.
translations.idiomatic: The cause lies in Lu Congshi first making the ladder of disorder, raising troops throughout the realm and producing chaos within the seas—neither loyal to the state nor filial to his house.

sentences.zh: 當其聞父之喪，已變為臣之節，迫脅天使，瀆紊朝經。

translations.literal: When he heard of his father's death he had already changed to a subject's ritual, coerced the imperial envoy, and defiled court regulations.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of his father's death he had already changed to a subject's ritual, coerced the imperial envoy, and defiled court regulations.

sentences.zh: 而乃幸臣居喪，敗臣求利，上敢欺於聖主，下不顧其死親；

translations.literal: Yet he took advantage of your subject's mourning, ruined your subject's seeking of profit, above daring to deceive the holy sovereign, below not caring for his dead parent.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he took advantage of your subject's mourning, ruined your subject's seeking of profit, above daring to deceive the holy sovereign, below not caring for his dead parent.

sentences.zh: 矯情徒見於封章，邪妄素萌於胸臆。

translations.literal: False feeling appeared only in sealed memorials; wicked deceit had long sprouted in the breast.
translations.idiomatic: False feeling appeared only in sealed memorials. Wicked deceit had long sprouted in the breast.

sentences.zh: 今構禍者已就擒獲，抱冤者實冀辯明。

translations.literal: Now the one who made disaster has been captured; the one who bears injustice truly hopes for clarification.
translations.idiomatic: Now the one who made disaster has been captured. The one who bears injustice truly hopes for clarification.

sentences.zh: 況臣之一軍，素守忠義，橫被從史離間君臣，哀號轅門，痛隔恩外。

translations.literal: Moreover this army of your subject has always kept loyalty and righteousness, wrongly sundered in lord-and-subject relations by Congshi; they wail at the camp gate, pain severing them from grace beyond.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover this army of your subject has always kept loyalty and righteousness, wrongly sundered in lord-and-subject relations by Congshi. They wail at the camp gate, pain severing them from grace beyond.

sentences.zh: 伏冀陛下以天地之德，容納為心；

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty, with the virtue of heaven and earth, will take tolerance as heart.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope Your Majesty, with the virtue of heaven and earth, will take tolerance as heart.

sentences.zh: 弘好生之仁，許自新之路。

translations.literal: Extend the benevolence that cherishes life and grant the road of self-renewal.
translations.idiomatic: Extend the benevolence that cherishes life and grant the road of self-renewal.

sentences.zh: 順陽和而布澤，因雷雨以覃恩。

translations.literal: Follow the yang harmony and spread bounty; through thunder rain extend grace.
translations.idiomatic: Follow the yang harmony and spread bounty; through thunder rain extend grace.

sentences.zh: 追念祖父之前勞，俯觀臣子之來效，特開湯網，使樂堯年。

translations.literal: Recall the former merit of grandfather and father; look down on your subject's coming submission; specially open the net of Tang and let them rejoice in the years of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Recall the former merit of grandfather and father. Look down on your subject's coming submission. Specially open the net of Tang and let them rejoice in the years of Yao.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷以承璀宿師無功，國威日沮，頗憂。

translations.literal: At that time the court, because Chengcui long garrisoned troops without merit and national prestige daily declined, was quite worried.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court, because Chengcui long garrisoned troops without merit and national prestige daily declined, was quite worried.

sentences.zh: 會承宗使至，宰臣商量，請行赦宥，乃全以六郡付之。

translations.literal: When Chengzong's envoy arrived, the chief ministers discussed and asked to grant amnesty; the six commanderies were then fully restored to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong's envoy arrived, the chief ministers discussed and asked to grant amnesty. The six commanderies were then fully restored to him.

sentences.zh: 承宗送薛昌朝入朝，授以右武衛將軍。

translations.literal: Chengzong sent Xue Changchao to court and appointed him General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong sent Xue Changchao to court and appointed him General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 承宗以國家加兵不勝，誣從史奸計得行，雖上章表謙恭，而心無忌憚。

translations.literal: Chengzong, because the state added troops and could not prevail, thought Congshi's treacherous plan had succeeded; though his memorials were deferential, in heart he had no fear.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong, because the state added troops and could not prevail, thought Congshi's treacherous plan had succeeded. Though his memorials were deferential, in heart he had no fear.

sentences.zh: 十年，王師討吳元濟，承宗與李師道繼獻章表，請宥元濟。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the imperial army attacked Wu Yuanji; Chengzong with Li Shidao in succession submitted memorials asking pardon for Yuanji.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the imperial army attacked Wu Yuanji. Chengzong with Li Shidao in succession submitted memorials asking pardon for Yuanji.

sentences.zh: 其牙將尹少卿奏事，因為元濟遊說。

translations.literal: His yamen general Yin Shaoqing, reporting affairs, also lobbied on Yuanji's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: His yamen general Yin Shaoqing, reporting affairs, also lobbied on Yuanji's behalf.

sentences.zh: 少卿至中書，見宰相論列，語意不遜；

translations.literal: Shaoqing came to the Secretariat and debated with the chancellor; his words were not deferential.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoqing came to the Secretariat and debated with the chancellor. His words were not deferential.

sentences.zh: 武元衡怒，叱出之，承宗益不順。

translations.literal: Wu Yuanheng was angry and shouted him out; Chengzong grew more disobedient.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanheng was angry and shouted him out. Chengzong grew more disobedient.

sentences.zh: 自是與李師道奸計百端，以沮用兵。

translations.literal: From this he with Li Shidao plotted by a hundred paths to obstruct the use of troops.
translations.idiomatic: From this he with Li Shidao plotted by a hundred paths to obstruct the use of troops.

sentences.zh: 四月，遣盜燒河陰倉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he sent assassins to burn the Heyang granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he sent assassins to burn the Heyang granary.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣盜伏於靖安裏，殺宰相武元衡，京師震恐，大索旬日，天子為之旰食。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he sent assassins to lie in wait at Jing'an Lane and kill Chancellor Wu Yuanheng; the capital was shaken with fear; a great search lasted ten days; the emperor went without proper meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he sent assassins to lie in wait at Jing'an Lane and kill Chancellor Wu Yuanheng. The capital was shaken with fear. A great search lasted ten days. The emperor went without proper meals.

sentences.zh: 是時，承宗、師道之盜，所在竊發，焚襄州佛寺，斬建陵門戟，燒獻陵寢宮，欲伏甲屠洛陽。

translations.literal: At that time the assassins of Chengzong and Shidao stole out everywhere, burned Xiangyang Buddhist temples, cut down the Jianling gate halberds, burned the Xianling palace quarters, and plotted to lie in ambush and massacre Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the assassins of Chengzong and Shidao stole out everywhere, burned Xiangyang Buddhist temples, cut down the Jianling gate halberds, burned the Xianling palace quarters, and plotted to lie in ambush and massacre Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 憲宗赫怒，命田弘正出師臨其境，並鄰道六節度之眾討之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong blazed with anger and ordered Tian Hongzheng to lead troops to the border and join the armies of six neighboring circuits to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong blazed with anger and ordered Tian Hongzheng to lead troops to the border and join the armies of six neighboring circuits to attack him.

sentences.zh: 時方淮西用兵，國用虛竭，河北諸軍多觀望不進。

translations.literal: At that time troops were being used on the Huai west; state use was empty and exhausted; the Hebei armies mostly watched and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time troops were being used on the Huai west. State use was empty and exhausted. The Hebei armies mostly watched and did not advance.

sentences.zh: 獨昭義節度使郗士美率精兵壓賊壘，欲乘釁而取之，軍威甚盛。

translations.literal: Only Zhaoyi military commissioner Xi Shimei led crack troops to press the rebel ramparts, wishing to seize the breach and take them; military prestige was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhaoyi military commissioner Xi Shimei led crack troops to press the rebel ramparts, wishing to seize the breach and take them. Military prestige was very great.

sentences.zh: 承宗懼，不敢犯。

translations.literal: Chengzong was afraid and dared not attack.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was afraid and dared not attack.

sentences.zh: 俄詔權罷河北用兵，並力淮西。

translations.literal: Soon an edict temporarily halted Hebei military action and combined strength on the Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict temporarily halted Hebei military action and combined strength on the Huai west.

sentences.zh: 十二年十月，誅吳元濟，承宗始懼，求救於田弘正。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twelfth year Wu Yuanji was executed; Chengzong then grew afraid and begged Tian Hongzheng for rescue.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twelfth year Wu Yuanji was executed. Chengzong then grew afraid and begged Tian Hongzheng for rescue.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，弘正遣人送承宗男知感、知信及其牙將石汛等詣闕請命，令於客舍安置；

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year Hongzheng sent men to escort Chengzong's sons Zhigan and Zhixin and his yamen generals Shi Xun and the like to court to beg for orders, ordering them lodged in the guest quarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year Hongzheng sent men to escort Chengzong's sons Zhigan and Zhixin and his yamen generals Shi Xun and the like to court to beg for orders, ordering them lodged in the guest quarters.

sentences.zh: 又獻德、棣二州圖印，兼請入管內租稅，除補官吏。

translations.literal: He also offered the seals of De and Di prefectures and asked to remit taxes within his jurisdiction and appoint officials by court order.
translations.idiomatic: He also offered the seals of De and Di prefectures and asked to remit taxes within his jurisdiction and appoint officials by court order.

sentences.zh: 上以弘正表疏相繼，重違其意，乃下詔曰：

translations.literal: Because Hongzheng's memorials followed one after another and the emperor heavily declined to go against his intent, he then issued an edict:
translations.idiomatic: Because Hongzheng's memorials followed one after another and the emperor heavily declined to go against his intent, he then issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 帝者承天子人，下臨萬國。

translations.literal: The emperor receives heaven's mandate and faces down the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor receives heaven's mandate and faces down the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 觀乾坤覆載之施，常務其曲全；

translations.literal: Observing heaven and earth's covering and bearing grace, he always seeks to bend and preserve whole.
translations.idiomatic: Observing heaven and earth's covering and bearing grace, he always seeks to bend and preserve whole.

sentences.zh: 用德刑撫禦之方，每先其弘貸。

translations.literal: In methods of comforting and governing with virtue and punishment, he always first extends great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: In methods of comforting and governing with virtue and punishment, he always first extends great pardon.

sentences.zh: 叛則必伐，服而舍之，訪於典謨，亦尚斯道。

translations.literal: Rebel and you must strike; submit and you release—this is sought in the canon and also honored in this Way.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel and you must strike; submit and you release—this is sought in the canon and also honored in this Way.

sentences.zh: 朕祗符前訓，纘嗣丕圖，底寧方隅，蕩滌氛祲。

translations.literal: I reverently follow former instruction and continue the great design, pacifying the corners and washing away miasma.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently follow former instruction and continue the great design, pacifying the corners and washing away miasma.

sentences.zh: 上以攄祖宗之宿憤，下以致黎庶之阜康，思厚者生，務去者殺。

translations.literal: Above to vent the ancestors' old rage; below to bring the people's abundance and peace—think of the thick in giving life, strive to remove in killing.
translations.idiomatic: Above to vent the ancestors' old rage; below to bring the people's abundance and peace—think of the thick in giving life, strive to remove in killing.

sentences.zh: 至於包荒藏慝，屈法伸恩，茍衷誠之可矜，則宥過而無大。

translations.literal: As for embracing the wild and hiding wickedness, bending law to extend grace—if sincere feeling can be pitied, then forgive the fault as not great.
translations.idiomatic: As for embracing the wild and hiding wickedness, bending law to extend grace—if sincere feeling can be pitied, then forgive the fault as not great.

sentences.zh: 王承宗頃居喪紀，見賣於鄰封；

translations.literal: Wang Chengzong lately in mourning discipline was sold out by neighboring circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong lately in mourning discipline was sold out by neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 後鄰籓城，受疑於朝野。

translations.literal: Later neighboring circuits walled cities and he was suspected by court and countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Later neighboring circuits walled cities and he was suspected by court and countryside.

sentences.zh: 國恩雖厚，時憲不容。

translations.literal: Though national grace was thick, the times' law would not contain him.
translations.idiomatic: Though national grace was thick, the times' law would not contain him.

sentences.zh: 戚實自貽，寵非我絕。

translations.literal: Sorrow he brought on himself; favor was not cut off by me.
translations.idiomatic: Sorrow he brought on himself; favor was not cut off by me.

sentences.zh: 百辟卿士，昌言在廷；

translations.literal: The hundred ranks of ministers spoke clearly in court.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred ranks of ministers spoke clearly in court.

sentences.zh: 四方諸侯，飛奏盈篋，競請致討，爭先出軍。

translations.literal: The feudal lords of the four directions, flying memorials filling boxes, all asked to launch punishment and vied to send out armies.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords of the four directions, flying memorials filling boxes, all asked to launch punishment and vied to send out armies.

sentences.zh: 尚復廣示招懷，務存容納，至於動眾，事豈願然！

translations.literal: Still I broadly showed recruitment and cherishing and strove to contain and accept—when it came to moving the hosts, was the matter what I wished!
translations.idiomatic: Still I broadly showed recruitment and cherishing and strove to contain and accept—when it came to moving the hosts, was the matter what I wished!

sentences.zh: 開境湣罹其殺傷，退舍為伏其士伍，取陷救溺，能無慘嗟！

translations.literal: Opening borders grieved at their killing and wounding; withdrawing encampments bowed to their soldiers and ranks—taking the fallen to save the drowning, how could there be no bitter sighs!
translations.idiomatic: Opening borders grieved at their killing and wounding; withdrawing encampments bowed to their soldiers and ranks—taking the fallen to save the drowning, how could there be no bitter sighs!

sentences.zh: 以其先祖武俊，有勞王室，書於甲令，銘在景鐘；

translations.literal: Because his ancestor Wujun had merit to the royal house, it is written in the armored command and engraved on the sounding bell.
translations.idiomatic: Because his ancestor Wujun had merit to the royal house, it is written in the armored command and engraved on the sounding bell.

sentences.zh: 雖再駕王師，再從人欲，而十代之宥，常切朕懷。

translations.literal: Though twice the royal army was driven and twice the people's wish followed, the pardon of ten generations has always cut my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Though twice the royal army was driven and twice the people's wish followed, the pardon of ten generations has always cut my heart.

sentences.zh: 近以三朝稱慶，八表流澤，廣此鴻霈，開其自新。

translations.literal: Lately on the three courts' celebration the eight directions flowed with bounty; I broadened this great rain and opened the road of self-renewal.
translations.idiomatic: Lately on the three courts' celebration the eight directions flowed with bounty. I broadened this great rain and opened the road of self-renewal.

sentences.zh: 而承宗果能翻然改圖，披露忠懇，遠遣二子，進陳表章，緘圖印以上聞，獻德、棣之名部，發囷奉粟，並竈貢鹽，地願帥於職方，物請歸於司會。

translations.literal: And Chengzong was able to turn and change his course, reveal loyal sincerity, send his two sons from afar, submit memorials, seal maps and seals to report above, offer the name-departments of De and Di, open granaries and present grain, share stoves and present salt, wish the land led by the territorial office, and goods returned to the treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: And Chengzong was able to turn and change his course, reveal loyal sincerity, send his two sons from afar, submit memorials, seal maps and seals to report above, offer the name-departments of De and Di, open granaries and present grain, share stoves and present salt, wish the land led by the territorial office, and goods returned to the treasurer.

sentences.zh: 且天子所臨，莫非王土；

translations.literal: Moreover where the Son of Heaven faces—all is royal land.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover where the Son of Heaven faces—all is royal land.

sentences.zh: 析茲舊服，將表爾誠，諒由效順之心，悉見納忠之誌，抑而不撫，何以示懷。

translations.literal: Dividing this old domain will show your sincerity; surely from the heart of effecting obedience all see the will of offering loyalty—if I suppress and do not comfort, how show cherishing?
translations.idiomatic: Dividing this old domain will show your sincerity. Surely from the heart of effecting obedience all see the will of offering loyalty—if I suppress and do not comfort, how show cherishing?

sentences.zh: 朕念此方，亦猶赤子，一物失所，寢興靡寧；

translations.literal: I think of this region also as an infant; one thing lost and sleep and rising are never at peace.
translations.idiomatic: I think of this region also as an infant. One thing lost and sleep and rising are never at peace.

sentences.zh: 忍驅樂土之人，竟就陳原之戮！

translations.literal: How could I drive the people of happy land to the slaughter of the open plain!
translations.idiomatic: How could I drive the people of happy land to the slaughter of the open plain!

sentences.zh: 既克翦暴，常思止戈，予之此心，天地臨鑒。

translations.literal: Having cut down the violent, I always think to stop the spear; this heart of mine heaven and earth witness.
translations.idiomatic: Having cut down the violent, I always think to stop the spear. This heart of mine heaven and earth witness.

sentences.zh: 況常山師旅，舊有功勞，將改往以修來，誓酬恩而遷善，鑒精誠之俱切，俾渙汗而再敷。

translations.literal: Moreover the Changshan army of old had merit; they will change the past to repair the future, vow to repay grace and move to good—seeing sincere feeling equally urgent, I make the edict flow again.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Changshan army of old had merit. They will change the past to repair the future, vow to repay grace and move to good—seeing sincere feeling equally urgent, I make the edict flow again.

sentences.zh: 曠滌乃愆，斷於朕誌；

translations.literal: Wash away transgressions—decided in my will.
translations.idiomatic: Wash away transgressions—decided in my will.

sentences.zh: 復此殊渥，當懷永圖。

translations.literal: Restore this special favor—you must cherish an eternal design.
translations.idiomatic: Restore this special favor—you must cherish an eternal design.

sentences.zh: 承宗可依前銀青光祿大夫、檢校吏部尚書、鎮州大都督府長史、御史大夫，充成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙觀察等使。

translations.literal: Chengzong may resume his former offices of Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Minister of Civil Affairs, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong may resume his former offices of Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Minister of Civil Affairs, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 仍令右丞崔從往鎮州宣慰。

translations.literal: Also Vice Director Cui Cong was ordered to go to Zhen Prefecture to proclaim comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Also Vice Director Cui Cong was ordered to go to Zhen Prefecture to proclaim comfort.

sentences.zh: 承宗素服俟命，乃以華州刺史鄭權為德州刺史，充橫海軍節度、德棣滄景觀察等使。

translations.literal: Chengzong in plain garb awaited orders; then Hua Prefecture prefect Zheng Quan was made prefect of De Prefecture and military commissioner of the Henghai Army and commissioner of De, Di, Cang, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong in plain garb awaited orders. Then Hua Prefecture prefect Zheng Quan was made prefect of De Prefecture and military commissioner of the Henghai Army and commissioner of De, Di, Cang, and Jing.

sentences.zh: 明年，加金紫光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: The next year he was further made Gold Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was further made Gold Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，李師道平，承宗奉法逾謹，請當管四州，每州置錄事參軍一員、判司三員，每縣令一員、主簿一員，吏補授皆聽朝旨。

translations.literal: That year Li Shidao was pacified; Chengzong observed the law ever more strictly and asked that in each of the four prefectures under his charge one recording secretary, three case reviewers per prefecture, one magistrate and one registrar per county be appointed—all subordinate appointments to follow court order.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Shidao was pacified. Chengzong observed the law ever more strictly and asked that in each of the four prefectures under his charge one recording secretary, three case reviewers per prefecture, one magistrate and one registrar per county be appointed—all subordinate appointments to follow court order.

sentences.zh: 十五年十一月卒，贈侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifteenth year he died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifteenth year he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 子知感、知信在朝。

translations.literal: His sons Zhigan and Zhixin were at court.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Zhigan and Zhixin were at court.

sentences.zh: 承元，士真第二子。

translations.literal: Chengyuan was Shizhen's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan was Shizhen's second son.

sentences.zh: 兄承宗既領節鉞，奏承元為觀察支使、朝議郎、左金吾衛胄曹參軍，兼監察御史，年始十六。

translations.literal: After his elder brother Chengzong took the commissioner's baton, he memorialized Chengyuan as observation staff officer, Court Gentleman for Consultation, Left Golden Guard Army Cadet, and Concurrent Investigating Censor—he was only sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: After his elder brother Chengzong took the commissioner's baton, he memorialized Chengyuan as observation staff officer, Court Gentleman for Consultation, Left Golden Guard Army Cadet, and Concurrent Investigating Censor—he was only sixteen.

sentences.zh: 勸承宗以二千騎佐王師平李師道，承宗不能用其言。

translations.literal: He urged Chengzong with two thousand horsemen to aid the imperial army in pacifying Li Shidao; Chengzong could not use his advice.
translations.idiomatic: He urged Chengzong with two thousand horsemen to aid the imperial army in pacifying Li Shidao. Chengzong could not use his advice.

sentences.zh: 元和十五年冬，承宗卒，秘不發喪，大將謀取帥於旁郡。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year of Yuanhe Chengzong died; the death was kept secret; great generals plotted to take the command from a neighboring commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifteenth year of Yuanhe Chengzong died. The death was kept secret. Great generals plotted to take the command from a neighboring commandery.

sentences.zh: 時參謀崔燧密與握兵者謀，乃以祖母涼國夫人之命，告親兵及諸將，使拜承元。

translations.literal: At that time staff officer Cui Sui secretly plotted with those who held troops and, by the order of the grandmother, Lady of Liang, told the personal guard and all generals to bow to Chengyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time staff officer Cui Sui secretly plotted with those who held troops and, by the order of the grandmother, Lady of Liang, told the personal guard and all generals to bow to Chengyuan.

sentences.zh: 承元拜泣不受，諸將請之不已。

translations.literal: Chengyuan bowed and wept and would not accept; the generals repeatedly asked him.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan bowed and wept and would not accept. The generals repeatedly asked him.

sentences.zh: 承元曰：「天子使中貴人監軍，有事盍先與議。」

translations.literal: Chengyuan said: "The Son of Heaven sends an inner attendant to supervise the army—if there is business, should we not first discuss with him?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan said, "The Son of Heaven sends an inner attendant to supervise the army—if there is business, should we not first discuss with him?"

sentences.zh: 及監軍至，因以諸將意贊之。

translations.literal: When the supervisor arrived, he thereby endorsed the generals' intent.
translations.idiomatic: When the supervisor arrived, he thereby endorsed the generals' intent.

sentences.zh: 承元謂諸將曰：「諸公未忘先德，不以承元齒幼，欲使領事。

translations.literal: Chengyuan said to the generals: "You have not forgotten the former lord's virtue and, not thinking Chengyuan young, wish to have him lead affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan said to the generals, "You have not forgotten the former lord's virtue and, not thinking Chengyuan young, wish to have him lead affairs.

sentences.zh: 承元欲效忠於國，以奉先誌，諸公能從之乎？」

translations.literal: Chengyuan wishes to show loyalty to the state and follow the former will—will you follow me in this?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan wishes to show loyalty to the state and follow the former will—will you follow me in this?"

sentences.zh: 諸將許諾。

translations.literal: The generals promised.
translations.idiomatic: The generals promised.

sentences.zh: 遂於衙門都將所理視事，約左右不得呼留後，事無巨細，決之參佐。

translations.literal: He then conducted affairs at the yamen gate commander's office, stipulating that those around should not call him acting commissioner; nothing great or small was decided except by staff.
translations.idiomatic: He then conducted affairs at the yamen gate commander's office, stipulating that those around should not call him acting commissioner. Nothing great or small was decided except by staff.

sentences.zh: 密疏請帥，天子嘉之，授銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書，兼滑州刺史、義成軍節度、鄭滑觀察等使。

translations.literal: He secretly memorialized asking for a commander; the Son of Heaven commended him and appointed him Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Vice Minister of Works, concurrent prefect of Hua Prefecture, military commissioner of the Yicheng Army and commissioner of Zheng and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly memorialized asking for a commander. The Son of Heaven commended him and appointed him Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Vice Minister of Works, concurrent prefect of Hua Prefecture, military commissioner of the Yicheng Army and commissioner of Zheng and Hua.

sentences.zh: 鄰鎮以兩河近事諷之，承元不聽，諸將亦悔。

translations.literal: Neighboring circuits, citing recent events in the two rivers, tried to persuade him; Chengyuan would not listen; the generals also repented.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring circuits, citing recent events in the two rivers, tried to persuade him. Chengyuan would not listen. The generals also repented.

sentences.zh: 及起居舍人柏耆賫詔宣諭滑州之命，兵士或拜或泣。

translations.literal: When Attendant of the Emperor's Actions Bo Qi bore the edict proclaiming the Hua Prefecture appointment, some soldiers bowed and some wept.
translations.idiomatic: When Attendant of the Emperor's Actions Bo Qi bore the edict proclaiming the Hua Prefecture appointment, some soldiers bowed and some wept.

sentences.zh: 承元與柏耆於館驛召諸將諭之，諸將號哭喧嘩。

translations.literal: Chengyuan with Bo Qi at the relay station summoned the generals to admonish them; the generals wailed and clamored.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan with Bo Qi at the relay station summoned the generals to admonish them. The generals wailed and clamored.

sentences.zh: 承元詰之曰：「諸公以先世之故，不欲承元失此，意甚隆厚；

translations.literal: Chengyuan questioned them: "You, because of the former generations, did not wish Chengyuan to lose this—your intent is very generous.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan questioned them, "You, because of the former generations, did not wish Chengyuan to lose this—your intent is very generous.

sentences.zh: 然奉詔遲留，其罪大矣！

translations.literal: Yet to delay obeying the edict is a great crime!
translations.idiomatic: Yet to delay obeying the edict is a great crime!

sentences.zh: 前者李師道未敗時，議赦其罪，時師道欲行，諸將止之，他日殺師道，亦諸將也！

translations.literal: Earlier when Li Shidao had not yet been defeated, there was talk of pardoning his crime; at that time Shidao wished to go and the generals stopped him—later when Shidao was killed, that too was the generals!
translations.idiomatic: Earlier when Li Shidao had not yet been defeated, there was talk of pardoning his crime. At that time Shidao wished to go and the generals stopped him—later when Shidao was killed, that too was the generals!

sentences.zh: 今公輩辛勿為師道之事，敢以拜請。」

translations.literal: Now you must not do as with Shidao—I beg you with this bow."
translations.idiomatic: Now you must not do as with Shidao—I beg you with this bow."

sentences.zh: 遂拜諸將，泣涕不自勝。

translations.literal: He then bowed to the generals, weeping beyond control.
translations.idiomatic: He then bowed to the generals, weeping beyond control.

sentences.zh: 承元乃盡出家財，籍其人以散之，酌其勤者擢之。

translations.literal: Chengyuan then brought out all family wealth, registered the people and distributed it, and promoted the diligent.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan then brought out all family wealth, registered the people and distributed it, and promoted the diligent.

sentences.zh: 牙將李寂等十數人固留承元，斬寂等，軍中始定。

translations.literal: Yamen general Li Ji and more than ten others firmly detained Chengyuan; Ji and the others were beheaded and the army was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen general Li Ji and more than ten others firmly detained Chengyuan. Ji and the others were beheaded and the army was then settled.

sentences.zh: 承元出鎮州，時年十八，所從將吏，有具器用貨幣而行者，承元悉命留之。

translations.literal: Chengyuan left Zhen Prefecture at eighteen; of the generals and clerks who followed, some had prepared utensils, goods, and currency to travel—Chengyuan ordered all left behind.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan left Zhen Prefecture at eighteen. Of the generals and clerks who followed, some had prepared utensils, goods, and currency to travel—Chengyuan ordered all left behind.

sentences.zh: 承元昆弟及從父昆弟，授郡守者四人，登朝者四人，從事將校有勞者，亦皆擢用。

translations.literal: Chengyuan's brothers and cousins by the father's line were given four as prefects and four entered court; staff and commanders with merit were also all promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan's brothers and cousins by the father's line were given four as prefects and four entered court. Staff and commanders with merit were also all promoted.

sentences.zh: 祖母涼國夫人入朝，穆宗命內宮筵待，錫賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The grandmother, Lady of Liang, entered court; Emperor Muzong ordered inner-palace banquets and bestowed gifts very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The grandmother, Lady of Liang, entered court. Emperor Muzong ordered inner-palace banquets and bestowed gifts very generously.

sentences.zh: 俄而王廷湊殺田弘正，據鎮州叛。

translations.literal: Soon Wang Tingcou killed Tian Hongzheng and held Zhen Prefecture in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wang Tingcou killed Tian Hongzheng and held Zhen Prefecture in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 移鎮鄜坊丹延節度使，便道請覲，穆宗器之，數召顧問。

translations.literal: He was transferred as military commissioner of Fufang, Dan, and Yan and on the way asked to attend court; Emperor Muzong valued him and repeatedly summoned him for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred as military commissioner of Fufang, Dan, and Yan and on the way asked to attend court. Emperor Muzong valued him and repeatedly summoned him for consultation.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was changed to Fengxiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔西北界接涇原，無山谷之險，吐蕃由是徑往入寇。

translations.literal: Fengxiang's northwest border adjoined Jingyuan; there were no mountain valleys for defense, and Tibet therefore took the direct road to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang's northwest border adjoined Jingyuan. There were no mountain valleys for defense, and Tibet therefore took the direct road to raid.

sentences.zh: 承元於要沖築壘，分兵千人守之，賜名曰臨汧城。

translations.literal: Chengyuan at a strategic point built ramparts and divided a thousand men to guard them; the name granted was Linqiancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan at a strategic point built ramparts and divided a thousand men to guard them. The name granted was Linqiancheng.

sentences.zh: 詔襲岐國公，累加檢校左僕射。

translations.literal: An edict granted succession to Duke of Qi; he was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted succession to Duke of Qi. He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔城東，商旅所集，居人多以烽火相警，承元奏益城以環之。

translations.literal: East of Fengxiang city merchants gathered; residents often took beacon fires as warning; Chengyuan memorialized to enlarge the city and ring it round.
translations.idiomatic: East of Fengxiang city merchants gathered. Residents often took beacon fires as warning. Chengyuan memorialized to enlarge the city and ring it round.

sentences.zh: 居鎮十年，加檢校司空、御史大夫，移授平盧軍節度、淄青登萊觀察等使。

translations.literal: After ten years in the post he was further made Acting Minister of Works and Censor-in-Chief and transferred as military commissioner of the Pinglu Army and commissioner of Zi, Qing, Deng, and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: After ten years in the post he was further made Acting Minister of Works and Censor-in-Chief and transferred as military commissioner of the Pinglu Army and commissioner of Zi, Qing, Deng, and Lai.

sentences.zh: 時均輸鹽法未嘗行於兩河，承元首請鹽法，歸之有司，自是兗、鄆諸鎮，皆稟均輸之法。

translations.literal: At that time the equalized transport salt law had never been applied in the two rivers; Chengyuan first requested the salt law and returned proceeds to the relevant offices; from this Yan and Yun circuits all followed the equalized transport law.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the equalized transport salt law had never been applied in the two rivers. Chengyuan first requested the salt law and returned proceeds to the relevant offices. From this Yan and Yun circuits all followed the equalized transport law.

sentences.zh: 承元寬惠有制，所理稱治。

translations.literal: Chengyuan was generous and measured in rule; what he governed was called well ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan was generous and measured in rule. What he governed was called well ordered.

sentences.zh: 太和七年十二月，卒於平盧，時年三十三，冊贈司徒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of Taihe he died at Pinglu at thirty-three; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of Taihe he died at Pinglu at thirty-three. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 王廷湊，本回鶻阿布思之種族，世隸安東都護府。

translations.literal: Wang Tingcou was originally of the Abu Si clan of the Uyghurs and for generations was subordinate to the Anton Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingcou was originally of the Abu Si clan of the Uyghurs and for generations was subordinate to the Anton Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 曾祖曰五哥之，事李寶臣父子。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather was Wugezhi and served Li Baochen and his son.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather was Wugezhi and served Li Baochen and his son.

sentences.zh: 王武俊養為假子，驍果善鬥，武俊愛之。

translations.literal: Wang Wujun adopted him as a foster son; he was fierce and good in battle; Wujun loved him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wujun adopted him as a foster son. He was fierce and good in battle. Wujun loved him.

sentences.zh: 以軍功累授左武衛將軍同正，贈越州都督。

translations.literal: Through military merit he was repeatedly appointed Left Martial Guard General of the same rank and posthumously enfeoffed as Governor of Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Through military merit he was repeatedly appointed Left Martial Guard General of the same rank and posthumously enfeoffed as Governor of Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖末怛活，贈左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: His grandfather Modahuo was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Regular Attendant of the same rank.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Modahuo was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Regular Attendant of the same rank.

sentences.zh: 父升朝，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: His father Shengchao was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shengchao was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 皆以廷湊貴加贈典。

translations.literal: All were given added posthumous honors because of Tingcou's eminence.
translations.idiomatic: All were given added posthumous honors because of Tingcou's eminence.

sentences.zh: 祖父世為王氏騎將，累遷右職。

translations.literal: Grandfather and father for generations were cavalry generals of the Wang clan and were repeatedly promoted to high office.
translations.idiomatic: Grandfather and father for generations were cavalry generals of the Wang clan and were repeatedly promoted to high office.

sentences.zh: 廷湊沈勇寡言，雄猜有斷，為王承元衙內兵馬使。

translations.literal: Tingcou was deep, brave, and sparing of words, fierce and suspicious with decisive judgment, and was Wang Chengyuan's yamen inner cavalry commander.
