translations.idiomatic: Tingcou was deep, brave, and sparing of words, fierce and suspicious with decisive judgment, and was Wang Chengyuan's yamen inner cavalry commander.

sentences.zh: 初，承元上稟朝旨，田弘正帥成德軍，國家賞錢一百萬貫，度支輦運不時至，軍情不悅。

translations.literal: Earlier Chengyuan reported to court's order; Tian Hongzheng commanded the Chengde Army; the state rewarded one million strings of cash; transport from the revenue bureau did not arrive in time and army sentiment was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chengyuan reported to court's order. Tian Hongzheng commanded the Chengde Army. The state rewarded one million strings of cash. Transport from the revenue bureau did not arrive in time and army sentiment was displeased.

sentences.zh: 廷湊每抉其細故，激怒眾心。

translations.literal: Tingcou each time picked at small matters and inflamed the crowd's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou each time picked at small matters and inflamed the crowd's hearts.

sentences.zh: 會弘正以魏兵二千為衙隊，左右有備不能間。

translations.literal: When Hongzheng had two thousand Wei troops as yamen guard, guards on left and right were prepared and he could not come between.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongzheng had two thousand Wei troops as yamen guard, guards on left and right were prepared and he could not come between.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年六月，魏軍還鎮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Changqing the Wei army returned to its post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Changqing the Wei army returned to its post.

sentences.zh: 七月二十八日夜，廷湊乃結衙兵噪於府署；

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month Tingcou then joined yamen soldiers in clamor at headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month Tingcou then joined yamen soldiers in clamor at headquarters.

sentences.zh: 遲明，盡誅弘正與將吏家族三百余人。

translations.literal: At dawn he executed Hongzheng and the generals' and clerks' families—more than three hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he executed Hongzheng and the generals' and clerks' families—more than three hundred people.

sentences.zh: 廷湊自稱留後、知兵馬使，將吏逼監軍宋惟澄上章請授廷湊節鉞。

translations.literal: Tingcou styled himself acting commissioner and knowing military affairs; generals and clerks compelled supervisor Song Weicheng to submit a memorial asking that Tingcou be granted the banner and baton.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou styled himself acting commissioner and knowing military affairs. Generals and clerks compelled supervisor Song Weicheng to submit a memorial asking that Tingcou be granted the banner and baton.

sentences.zh: 穆宗怒，下詔征鄰道兵，仍以河東節度裴度充幽、鎮兩道招撫使，仍以弘正子涇原節度使布代李醖為魏博節度使，令率魏軍進討。

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong was angry and issued an edict mobilizing neighboring circuits; also Hedong military commissioner Pei Du was made pacification commissioner of You and Zhen; also Hongzheng's son Jingyuan military commissioner Bu replaced Li Yun as Weibo military commissioner and ordered to lead the Wei army in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong was angry and issued an edict mobilizing neighboring circuits. Also Hedong military commissioner Pei Du was made pacification commissioner of You and Zhen. Also Hongzheng's son Jingyuan military commissioner Bu replaced Li Yun as Weibo military commissioner and was ordered to lead the Wei army in advance.

sentences.zh: 又以承宗故將深州刺史牛元翼為成德軍節度使，下詔購誅廷湊。

translations.literal: Also Chengzong's former general Shen Prefecture prefect Niu Yuanji was made Chengde military commissioner; an edict offered a reward for killing Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: Also Chengzong's former general Shen Prefecture prefect Niu Yuanji was made Chengde military commissioner. An edict offered a reward for killing Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 是月，鎮州大將王位等謀殺廷湊事泄，坐死者二千余人。

translations.literal: That month Zhen Prefecture great general Wang Wei and others plotted to kill Tingcou; the affair leaked and more than two thousand were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhen Prefecture great general Wang Wei and others plotted to kill Tingcou. The affair leaked and more than two thousand were put to death.

sentences.zh: 時硃克融囚張弘靖，廷湊殺弘正，合從構逆謀，拒王命。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Kerong imprisoned Zhang Hongjing; Tingcou killed Hongzheng; they joined in plotting rebellion and resisted the royal command.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhu Kerong imprisoned Zhang Hongjing. Tingcou killed Hongzheng. They joined in plotting rebellion and resisted the royal command.

sentences.zh: 兩鎮並力，討除慮難應接，詔朝臣議其可否。

translations.literal: The two circuits combined strength; to attack and destroy them one feared difficulty in responding; an edict ordered court ministers to discuss whether it was feasible.
translations.idiomatic: The two circuits combined strength. To attack and destroy them one feared difficulty in responding. An edict ordered court ministers to discuss whether it was feasible.

sentences.zh: 東川節度使王涯獻狀曰：「幽、鎮兩州，悖亂天紀，迷亭育之厚德，肆狼虎之非心。

translations.literal: Dongchuan military commissioner Wang Ya submitted a memorial: "The You and Zhen circuits have rebelled against heaven's order, confused the deep grace of nurturing, and unleashed the unloyal heart of wolves and tigers.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan military commissioner Wang Ya submitted a memorial: "The You and Zhen circuits have rebelled against heaven's order, confused the deep grace of nurturing, and unleashed the unloyal heart of wolves and tigers.

sentences.zh: 囚縶鼎臣，戕賊戎帥，毒流州郡，釁及賓僚。

translations.literal: They imprisoned a pillar minister and killed and harmed the military commander; poison flowed through commanderies; offense reached guest officials.
translations.idiomatic: They imprisoned a pillar minister and killed and harmed the military commander. Poison flowed through commanderies. Offense reached guest officials.

sentences.zh: 凡在有情，孰不痛憤？

translations.literal: All who have feeling—who does not ache with rage?
translations.idiomatic: All who have feeling—who does not ache with rage?

sentences.zh: 伏以國家文德誕敷，武功繼立，遠無不伏，邇無不安，矧茲二方，敢逆天理。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that the state's civil virtue spreads afar and martial achievement stands in succession; far none do not submit, near none are not at peace—how much more these two regions daring to oppose heaven's principle.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider that the state's civil virtue spreads afar and martial achievement stands in succession. Far none do not submit, near none are not at peace—how much more these two regions daring to oppose heaven's principle.

sentences.zh: 臣竊料詔書朝下，諸鎮夕驅，以貔貅問罪之師，當猖狂失節之寇，傾山壓卵，決海灌熒，勢之相懸，不是過也。

translations.literal: Your subject estimates that when the edict descends at morning the circuits will drive at evening; with troops asking guilt of the fierce tiger, facing the frantic who lost measure—the mountain overturning the egg, the sea pouring on firefly—the disparity of force is not too strong a saying.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject estimates that when the edict descends at morning the circuits will drive at evening. With troops asking guilt of the fierce tiger, facing the frantic who lost measure—the mountain overturning the egg, the sea pouring on firefly—the disparity of force is not too strong a saying.

sentences.zh: 但常山、薊郡，虞、虢相依，一時興師，恐費財力。

translations.literal: But Changshan and Ji commandery, Yu and Guo depend on each other—if troops are raised at one time, I fear waste of wealth and strength.
translations.idiomatic: But Changshan and Ji commandery, Yu and Guo depend on each other—if troops are raised at one time, I fear waste of wealth and strength.

sentences.zh: 罪有輕重，事有後先，譬之攻堅，宜從易者。

translations.literal: Guilt has light and heavy; affairs have first and after—like attacking a stronghold, one should start with the easy.
translations.idiomatic: Guilt has light and heavy; affairs have first and after—like attacking a stronghold, one should start with the easy.

sentences.zh: 如聞范陽肇亂，出自一時，事非宿謀，跡亦可驗。

translations.literal: As I hear, Fanyang's disorder arose in one moment; it was not a long-planned affair; the traces can also be verified.
translations.idiomatic: As I hear, Fanyang's disorder arose in one moment. It was not a long-planned affair. The traces can also be verified.

sentences.zh: 鎮州構禍，殊匪偶然，扇諸屬城，以兵拒境。

translations.literal: Zhen Prefecture's disaster was by no means accidental; it incited all subordinate cities to resist the border with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Prefecture's disaster was by no means accidental. It incited all subordinate cities to resist the border with troops.

sentences.zh: 如此，則幽薊之眾，可示寬刑；

translations.literal: Thus the You-Ji hosts can be shown lenient punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the You-Ji hosts can be shown lenient punishment.

sentences.zh: 鎮冀之戎，可資先討。

translations.literal: The Zhen-Ji armies can be made to strike first.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhen-Ji armies can be made to strike first.

sentences.zh: 況廷湊阘茸，不席父祖之資；

translations.literal: Moreover Tingcou is mediocre and enjoys no patrimony from father and grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Tingcou is mediocre and enjoys no patrimony from father and grandfather.

sentences.zh: 成德分離，又多迫脅之勢。

translations.literal: Chengde is divided and there is much coercion.
translations.idiomatic: Chengde is divided and there is much coercion.

sentences.zh: 今以魏博思復仇之眾，昭義願盡敵之師，參之晉陽，輔以滄德，掎角而進，實若建瓴。

translations.literal: Now with Weibo's crowd thinking to avenge and Zhaoyi's army wishing to exhaust the foe, joining with Jinyang and aided by Cangde, advancing in pincer—it is truly like pouring from a high eave.
translations.idiomatic: Now with Weibo's crowd thinking to avenge and Zhaoyi's army wishing to exhaust the foe, joining with Jinyang and aided by Cangde, advancing in pincer—it is truly like pouring from a high eave.

sentences.zh: 盡屠其城，然後北首燕路，在朝廷不為失信，於軍勢實得機宜。

translations.literal: Slaughter the city entirely, then turn north to the Yan road—the court does not lose faith and in military situation one truly gains the opportune moment.
translations.idiomatic: Slaughter the city entirely, then turn north to the Yan road—the court does not lose faith and in military situation one truly gains the opportune moment.

sentences.zh: 臣之愚誠，切在於此。

translations.literal: Your subject's sincere foolishness cuts to this.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject's sincere foolishness cuts to this.

sentences.zh: 臣又聞用兵若鬥，先扼其喉。

translations.literal: Your subject also hears that in using troops as in fighting, first throttle the throat.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject also hears that in using troops as in fighting, first throttle the throat.

sentences.zh: 今瀛鄚、易定，兩賊之咽喉也。

translations.literal: Now Yingmo and Yiding are the two rebels' throat.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yingmo and Yiding are the two rebels' throat.

sentences.zh: 誠宜假之威柄，戍以重兵，俾其死生不相知，間諜無所入；

translations.literal: Truly one should lend them authority and garrison with heavy troops so that life and death do not know each other and spies have no entry.
translations.idiomatic: Truly one should lend them authority and garrison with heavy troops so that life and death do not know each other and spies have no entry.

sentences.zh: 而以大軍先進冀、趙，次臨井陘，此一舉萬全之勢也。」

translations.literal: Then with the great army first advance on Ji and Zhao, next approach Jingxing—this is the wholly secure posture in one move."
translations.idiomatic: Then with the great army first advance on Ji and Zhao, next approach Jingxing—this is the wholly secure posture in one move."

sentences.zh: 於是命易定節度使開境以抗克融，諸軍三面進討。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yiding military commissioner was ordered to open the border to resist Kerong; the armies on three sides advanced in attack.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yiding military commissioner was ordered to open the border to resist Kerong. The armies on three sides advanced in attack.

sentences.zh: 初，以滄德烏重胤獨當一面，重胤宿將，知不可進，頗遲留，乃以杜叔良代重胤。

translations.literal: Earlier Cangde's Wu Chongyin alone faced one front; Chongyin was a veteran commander and knew advance was impossible and quite delayed; then Du Shuliang replaced Chongyin.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Cangde's Wu Chongyin alone faced one front. Chongyin was a veteran commander and knew advance was impossible and quite delayed. Then Du Shuliang replaced Chongyin.

sentences.zh: 叔良有中官之援，朝辭日，大言云：「賊不足破。」

translations.literal: Shuliang had inner-attendant backing; on the day of court leave he spoke grandly: "The rebels are not worth breaking."
translations.idiomatic: Shuliang had inner-attendant backing. On the day of court leave he spoke grandly, "The rebels are not worth breaking."

sentences.zh: 時廷湊合幽薊之兵圍深州，梯沖雲合，牛元翼嬰城拒守。

translations.literal: At that time Tingcou combined You-Ji troops to besiege Shen Prefecture; scaling ladders and rams clouded together; Niu Yuanji held the city and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tingcou combined You-Ji troops to besiege Shen Prefecture. Scaling ladders and rams clouded together. Niu Yuanji held the city and resisted.

sentences.zh: 十一月，杜叔良為賊所敗，眾皆陷沒，僅以身免，乃以德州王日簡代之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Shuliang was defeated by the rebels; the host was mostly lost; he barely escaped with his body; then De Prefecture's Wang Rijian replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Shuliang was defeated by the rebels. The host was mostly lost. He barely escaped with his body. Then De Prefecture's Wang Rijian replaced him.

sentences.zh: 裴度率眾屯承天軍，諸將挫敗，深州危急。

translations.literal: Pei Du led troops encamped at Chengtian Army; the generals were defeated; Shen Prefecture was critically pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du led troops encamped at Chengtian Army. The generals were defeated. Shen Prefecture was critically pressed.

sentences.zh: 乃以鳳翔節度使李光顏為忠武節度使，兼深冀節度，救深州，仍以中官楊永和監光顏軍。

translations.literal: Then Fengxiang military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Zhongwu military commissioner and concurrent Shen-Ji commissioner to rescue Shen Prefecture; also the inner attendant Yang Yonghe was sent to supervise Guangyan's army.
translations.idiomatic: Then Fengxiang military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Zhongwu military commissioner and concurrent Shen-Ji commissioner to rescue Shen Prefecture. Also the inner attendant Yang Yonghe was sent to supervise Guangyan's army.

sentences.zh: 國家自憲宗誅除群盜，帑藏虛竭；

translations.literal: Since Emperor Xianzong executed and removed the bandits, the treasury was empty and exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Since Emperor Xianzong executed and removed the bandits, the treasury was empty and exhausted.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，賞賜過當；

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, rewards were excessive.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, rewards were excessive.

sentences.zh: 及幽、鎮共起，征發百端，財力殫竭。

translations.literal: When You and Zhen rose together, levies multiplied on every side and wealth and strength were utterly spent.
translations.idiomatic: When You and Zhen rose together, levies multiplied on every side and wealth and strength were utterly spent.

sentences.zh: 時諸鎮兵十五萬余，才出其境，便仰給度支，置南北供軍院。

translations.literal: At that time the circuits' troops were more than one hundred fifty thousand; as soon as they left their borders they relied on the revenue bureau for supply; north and south supply army offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the circuits' troops were more than one hundred fifty thousand. As soon as they left their borders they relied on the revenue bureau for supply. North and south supply army offices were established.

sentences.zh: 既深入賊境，輦運艱阻，芻薪不繼，諸軍多分番樵采。

translations.literal: Once deep in rebel territory, transport was hard and obstructed; fodder and fuel did not follow; the armies mostly took turns gathering firewood.
translations.idiomatic: Once deep in rebel territory, transport was hard and obstructed. Fodder and fuel did not follow. The armies mostly took turns gathering firewood.

sentences.zh: 俄而度支轉運車六百乘，盡為廷湊邀而虜之，兵食益困。

translations.literal: Soon six hundred revenue transport carts were all intercepted and captured by Tingcou; army food grew ever more distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon six hundred revenue transport carts were all intercepted and captured by Tingcou. Army food grew ever more distressed.

sentences.zh: 賊圍深州數重，雖光顏之善將，亦無以施其方略。

translations.literal: The rebels besieged Shen Prefecture in many rings; though Guangyan was a skilled commander, he too had no way to deploy strategy.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels besieged Shen Prefecture in many rings. Though Guangyan was a skilled commander, he too had no way to deploy strategy.

sentences.zh: 其供軍院布帛衣賜，往往不得至院，在途為諸軍強奪，而懸軍深鬥者，率無支給。

translations.literal: Cloth, silk, clothing, and gifts of the supply army offices often did not reach the offices; on the road they were forcibly seized by the armies, while those fighting deep with suspended armies mostly had no disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: Cloth, silk, clothing, and gifts of the supply army offices often did not reach the offices. On the road they were forcibly seized by the armies, while those fighting deep with suspended armies mostly had no disbursement.

sentences.zh: 復又每軍遣內官一人監軍，悉選驍健者自衛，羸懦者即戰，以是屢多奔北。

translations.literal: Again each army sent one inner attendant to supervise troops; all chose the fierce and strong for self-guard; the weak and timid then fought—thus there were many repeated routs.
translations.idiomatic: Again each army sent one inner attendant to supervise troops. All chose the fierce and strong for self-guard. The weak and timid then fought—thus there were many repeated routs.

sentences.zh: 而廷湊、克融之眾，不過萬余，而抗官軍十五萬者，良以統制不一，玩寇邀利故也。

translations.literal: Yet Tingcou and Kerong's hosts were no more than ten thousand-plus and resisted one hundred fifty thousand imperial troops—truly because command was not unified and they played with the foe and sought profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tingcou and Kerong's hosts were no more than ten thousand-plus and resisted one hundred fifty thousand imperial troops—truly because command was not unified and they played with the foe and sought profit.

sentences.zh: 宰相崔祐甫不曉兵家，膠柱於常態，以至復失河朔。

translations.literal: Chancellor Cui Youfu did not understand military affairs and clung rigidly to the normal pattern, until Hebei was again lost.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Cui Youfu did not understand military affairs and clung rigidly to the normal pattern, until Hebei was again lost.

sentences.zh: 既無如之何，遂議休兵而赦廷湊。

translations.literal: Having no remedy, they then discussed halting troops and pardoning Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: Having no remedy, they then discussed halting troops and pardoning Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，魏府牙將史憲誠誘其軍謀叛，田布不能止，其眾自潰於南宮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Weibo yamen general Shi Xianchang incited the army to plot rebellion; Tian Bu could not stop them; the host dissolved of itself at Nangong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Weibo yamen general Shi Xianchang incited the army to plot rebellion. Tian Bu could not stop them. The host dissolved of itself at Nangong.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔赦廷湊，仍授檢校右散騎常侍、鎮州大都督府長史、成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: In the second month an edict pardoned Tingcou and still appointed him Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict pardoned Tingcou and still appointed him Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, chief administrator of the Zhen Prefecture metropolitan prefecture, military commissioner of the Chengde Army and commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao and the like.

sentences.zh: 以牛元冀為山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Niu Yuanji was made military commissioner of Shannan East.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Yuanji was made military commissioner of Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 遣兵部侍郎韓愈至鎮州宣慰，又遣中使銜命入深州，監元翼赴鎮。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Han Yu was sent to Zhen Prefecture to proclaim comfort; also an inner attendant bearing credentials entered Shen Prefecture to supervise Yuanji's going to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of War Han Yu was sent to Zhen Prefecture to proclaim comfort. Also an inner attendant bearing credentials entered Shen Prefecture to supervise Yuanji's going to his post.

sentences.zh: 廷湊雖受命，而深州之圍不解。

translations.literal: Though Tingcou received appointment, the siege of Shen Prefecture was not lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Though Tingcou received appointment, the siege of Shen Prefecture was not lifted.

sentences.zh: 招撫使裴度與幽、鎮書，以大義責之；

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Pei Du wrote to You and Zhen with great principle to reprove them.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Pei Du wrote to You and Zhen with great principle to reprove them.

sentences.zh: 硃克融解圍而去，廷湊亦退舍。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong lifted the siege and left; Tingcou also withdrew encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Kerong lifted the siege and left. Tingcou also withdrew encampment.

sentences.zh: 朝廷欲其稟命，並加克融檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: The court wished them to obey orders and also added Kerong as Acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The court wished them to obey orders and also added Kerong as Acting Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三月，元翼率十余騎突圍出深州赴闕，深州將校臧平以城降。

translations.literal: In the third month Yuanji led more than ten horsemen to break the siege and leave Shen Prefecture for court; Shen Prefecture commander Zang Ping surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yuanji led more than ten horsemen to break the siege and leave Shen Prefecture for court. Shen Prefecture commander Zang Ping surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 廷湊責其固守，殺將吏一百八十余人。

translations.literal: Tingcou reproved them for stubborn defense and killed more than one hundred eighty generals and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou reproved them for stubborn defense and killed more than one hundred eighty generals and clerks.

sentences.zh: 五月，遣中使楊再昌至鎮州，取牛元翼家族及田弘正骸骨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month an inner attendant Yang Zaichang was sent to Zhen Prefecture to take Niu Yuanji's family and Tian Hongzheng's remains.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an inner attendant Yang Zaichang was sent to Zhen Prefecture to take Niu Yuanji's family and Tian Hongzheng's remains.

sentences.zh: 廷湊曰：「弘正骸骨，不知所在；

translations.literal: Tingcou said: "Hongzheng's remains—I do not know where they are.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou said, "Hongzheng's remains—I do not know where they are.

sentences.zh: 元翼家族，請至秋發遣。」

translations.literal: Yuanji's family—please wait until autumn for dispatch."
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji's family—please wait until autumn for dispatch."

sentences.zh: 俄而元翼卒，廷湊乃盡屠其家，其酷毒如此。

translations.literal: Soon Yuanji died; Tingcou then slaughtered his entire family—his cruelty was such.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Yuanji died. Tingcou then slaughtered his entire family—his cruelty was such.

sentences.zh: 自獲赦宥，遂與硃克融、史憲誠連衡相應，謀拒朝廷。

translations.literal: From receiving pardon he then with Zhu Kerong and Shi Xianchang allied in mutual response and plotted to resist the court.
translations.idiomatic: From receiving pardon he then with Zhu Kerong and Shi Xianchang allied in mutual response and plotted to resist the court.

sentences.zh: 太和初，滄州李全略死，其子同捷欲效河朔事，求代父任。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe Cang Prefecture's Li Quanlue died; his son Tongjie wished to imitate the Hebei affair and asked to replace his father.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe Cang Prefecture's Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie wished to imitate the Hebei affair and asked to replace his father.

sentences.zh: 文宗授以兗海節度使；

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong appointed him Yanhai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong appointed him Yanhai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同捷不奉詔，據郡構逆，以珍玩器幣妓女子弟投款於廷湊及幽州李載義。

translations.literal: Tongjie would not obey the edict, held the commandery and plotted rebellion, and sent precious objects, utensils, courtesans, sons, and daughters in submission to Tingcou and Youzhou's Li Zaiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Tongjie would not obey the edict, held the commandery and plotted rebellion, and sent precious objects, utensils, courtesans, sons, and daughters in submission to Tingcou and Youzhou's Li Zaiyi.

sentences.zh: 時載義初代克融，輸誠效順，盡送同捷所遣赴闕，詔征幽、魏、徐、兗之師進討。

translations.literal: At that time Zaiyi had just replaced Kerong, offered sincere obedience, and sent all Tongjie's envoys to court; an edict mobilized the armies of You, Wei, Xu, and Yan to advance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zaiyi had just replaced Kerong, offered sincere obedience, and sent all Tongjie's envoys to court. An edict mobilized the armies of You, Wei, Xu, and Yan to advance.

sentences.zh: 廷湊出兵撓魏北境，以援同捷。

translations.literal: Tingcou sent troops to harass Wei's northern border to aid Tongjie.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou sent troops to harass Wei's northern border to aid Tongjie.

sentences.zh: 二年，下詔絕廷湊進奉。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict cut off Tingcou's tribute presentations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict cut off Tingcou's tribute presentations.

sentences.zh: 既魏博將丌誌治以行營兵叛，倒戈攻魏州，諸軍擊誌治，廷湊出兵應之。

translations.literal: When Weibo general Qi Zhizhi rebelled with campaign troops and turned swords to attack Weizhou, the armies struck Zhizhi and Tingcou sent troops to respond.
translations.idiomatic: When Weibo general Qi Zhizhi rebelled with campaign troops and turned swords to attack Weizhou, the armies struck Zhizhi and Tingcou sent troops to respond.

sentences.zh: 史憲誠危急，詔義武軍節度使李聽擊敗之，誌治奔於廷湊。

translations.literal: Shi Xianchang was critically pressed; an edict ordered Yiwu military commissioner Li Ting to defeat him; Zhizhi fled to Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Xianchang was critically pressed. An edict ordered Yiwu military commissioner Li Ting to defeat him. Zhizhi fled to Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，誅李同捷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year Li Tongjie was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year Li Tongjie was executed.

sentences.zh: 尋又何進滔殺史憲誠，據魏州。

translations.literal: Soon He Jintao killed Shi Xianchang and held Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon He Jintao killed Shi Xianchang and held Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 朝廷厭兵，誅之不果，遂授進滔魏博節度。

translations.literal: The court was weary of war; execution did not succeed; Jintao was then appointed Weibo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The court was weary of war. Execution did not succeed. Jintao was then appointed Weibo military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，廷湊遣使詣闕請罪，朝廷因而赦之；

translations.literal: In the eighth month Tingcou sent an envoy to court to beg pardon; the court thereby pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tingcou sent an envoy to court to beg pardon. The court thereby pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 依前檢校司徒、成德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He resumed his former Acting Minister of Works and Chengde military commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: He resumed his former Acting Minister of Works and Chengde military commissionership.

sentences.zh: 鎮冀自李寶臣已來，雖惟嶽、承宗繼叛，而猶親鄰畏法，期自新之路。

translations.literal: Zhen-Ji from Li Baochen on, though Weiyue and Chengzong in succession rebelled, still treated kin and neighbors with fear of law and hoped for the road of self-renewal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen-Ji from Li Baochen on, though Weiyue and Chengzong in succession rebelled, still treated kin and neighbors with fear of law and hoped for the road of self-renewal.

sentences.zh: 而兇毒好亂，無君不仁，未如廷湊之甚也！

translations.literal: Yet for viciousness, love of disorder, lack of lord, and lack of benevolence, none was so extreme as Tingcou!
translations.idiomatic: Yet for viciousness, love of disorder, lack of lord, and lack of benevolence, none was so extreme as Tingcou!

sentences.zh: 又就加太子太傅、太原郡開國公，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: He was further made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: He was further made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月卒，冊贈太尉，累贈至太師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eighth year he died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal and repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eighth year he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal and repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 子元逵，為鎮州右司馬，兼都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: His son Yuankui was Zhen Prefecture Right Vice Administrator and concurrent commander of all military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yuankui was Zhen Prefecture Right Vice Administrator and concurrent commander of all military affairs.

sentences.zh: 廷湊卒，三軍推主軍事，請命於朝。

translations.literal: When Tingcou died the three armies pushed him to lead military affairs and asked orders from court.
translations.idiomatic: When Tingcou died the three armies pushed him to lead military affairs and asked orders from court.

sentences.zh: 乃起復檢校工部尚書、鎮州大都督府長史、成德軍節度使，累遷檢校左僕射。

translations.literal: He was recalled from mourning as Acting Vice Minister of Works, chief administrator of the Zhen metropolitan prefecture, and Chengde military commissioner, and was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled from mourning as Acting Vice Minister of Works, chief administrator of the Zhen metropolitan prefecture, and Chengde military commissioner, and was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 元逵素懷忠順，頓革父風。

translations.literal: Yuankui had long harbored loyal obedience and suddenly changed his father's ways.
translations.idiomatic: Yuankui had long harbored loyal obedience and suddenly changed his father's ways.

sentences.zh: 及領籓垣，頗輸誠款，歲時貢奉，結轍於途，文宗嘉之。

translations.literal: After taking the frontier he quite offered sincere regard; yearly tribute followed in trains on the road; Emperor Wenzong commended him.
translations.idiomatic: After taking the frontier he quite offered sincere regard. Yearly tribute followed in trains on the road. Emperor Wenzong commended him.

sentences.zh: 開成二年，詔以壽安公主出降，加駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaicheng an edict had Princess Shou'an descend in marriage; he was further made Commandant of the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaicheng an edict had Princess Shou'an descend in marriage. He was further made Commandant of the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 元逵遣段氏姑詣闕納聘禮。

translations.literal: Yuankui sent his paternal aunt of the Duan clan to court to present betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Yuankui sent his paternal aunt of the Duan clan to court to present betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 段氏進食二千盤，並禦衣戰馬、公主妝奩及私白身女口等，其從如雲，朝野榮之。

translations.literal: Lady Duan presented two thousand trays of food plus imperial robes, war horses, the princess's trousseau, and private attendants; her retinue was like clouds; court and countryside honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Duan presented two thousand trays of food plus imperial robes, war horses, the princess's trousseau, and private attendants. Her retinue was like clouds. Court and countryside honored it.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，昭義節度使劉從諫卒，其子稹擅領軍政；

translations.literal: In the Huichang era Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Congjian died; his son Zhen seized military government on his own.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Congjian died. His son Zhen seized military government on his own.

sentences.zh: 武宗怒，誅之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong was angry and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong was angry and executed him.

sentences.zh: 命鄰籓分地而進討，以元逵為北面招討使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered neighboring circuits to divide territory and advance in attack; Yuankui was made northern pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered neighboring circuits to divide territory and advance in attack. Yuankui was made northern pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔至之日，出師次趙州，與魏博何弘敬同收山東三州。

translations.literal: On the day the edict arrived he marched and encamped at Zhao Prefecture; with Weibo's He Hongjing he together recovered the three prefectures east of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the edict arrived he marched and encamped at Zhao Prefecture. With Weibo's He Hongjing he together recovered the three prefectures east of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 元逵進攻邢州，俄而賊將裴問、高元武降元逵，王釗、安玉降何弘敬，並拔三郡。

translations.literal: Yuankui advanced to attack Xing Prefecture; soon rebel generals Pei Wen and Gao Yuanwu surrendered to Yuankui; Wang Zhao and An Yu surrendered to He Hongjing; all three commanderies were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Yuankui advanced to attack Xing Prefecture. Soon rebel generals Pei Wen and Gao Yuanwu surrendered to Yuankui. Wang Zhao and An Yu surrendered to He Hongjing. All three commanderies were taken.

sentences.zh: 累遷檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Minister of Works and Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Minister of Works and Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以破劉稹功，加太傅、太原郡開國公，食邑二千戶，食實封二百戶。

translations.literal: For breaking Liu Zhen's merit he was further made Grand Tutor, Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households and a substantive fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: For breaking Liu Zhen's merit he was further made Grand Tutor, Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households and a substantive fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 太中十一年二月卒，冊贈太師，謚曰忠。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year of Dazhong he died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year of Dazhong he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Zhong.

sentences.zh: 子紹鼎、紹懿。

translations.literal: His sons were Shaoding and Shaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Shaoding and Shaoyi.

sentences.zh: 紹鼎，時為鎮州大都督府左司馬、知府事、節度副使、都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Shaoding was then Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, deputy military commissioner, and commander of all military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoding was then Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, deputy military commissioner, and commander of all military affairs.

sentences.zh: 起復授檢校工部尚書、鎮府長史、成德軍節度、鎮深冀趙觀察等使，累加光祿大夫、尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Recalled from mourning he was appointed Acting Vice Minister of Works, Zhen prefecture chief administrator, Chengde military commissioner and commissioner of Zhen, Shen, Ji, and Zhao, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled from mourning he was appointed Acting Vice Minister of Works, Zhen prefecture chief administrator, Chengde military commissioner and commissioner of Zhen, Shen, Ji, and Zhao, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 其年七月卒，贈司空，賻布帛三百段、米粟二百碩，累贈司徒、太尉，又贈太傅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year he died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works with three hundred rolls of cloth and silk and two hundred piculs of grain and millet as funeral gifts, and was repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Marshal and Grand Preceptor, then further enfeoffed as Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works with three hundred rolls of cloth and silk and two hundred piculs of grain and millet as funeral gifts, and was repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Marshal and Grand Preceptor, then further enfeoffed as Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 子景胤、景崇、景敔；

translations.literal: His sons were Jingyin, Jingchong, and Jing'ai.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Jingyin, Jingchong, and Jing'ai.

sentences.zh: 景崇為嫡，時年幼。

translations.literal: Jingchong was the legitimate heir and was still young.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchong was the legitimate heir and was still young.

sentences.zh: 紹鼎卒，宣宗以昭王汭為鎮州大都督、成德軍節度副使，都知兵馬使、檢校右散騎常侍、鎮府左司馬、知府事、兼御史中丞，王紹懿本官充成德軍節度、觀察留後，仍賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: When Shaoding died Emperor Xuanzong made Prince Zhao Wang the Zhen metropolitan prefect, Chengde deputy military commissioner, commander of all military affairs, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Zhen prefecture Left Vice Administrator knowing prefectural affairs and Concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief; Wang Shaoyi in his original office filled Chengde military commissioner and observation acting commissioner and was also granted the gold and purple fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoding died Emperor Xuanzong made Prince Zhao Wang the Zhen metropolitan prefect, Chengde deputy military commissioner, commander of all military affairs, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Zhen prefecture Left Vice Administrator knowing prefectural affairs and Concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief. Wang Shaoyi in his original office filled Chengde military commissioner and observation acting commissioner and was also granted the gold and purple fish bag.

sentences.zh: 尋正授節度使、檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 累加檢校右僕射、兼御史大夫、太原縣開國伯，食邑七百戶，又加檢校司空。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of seven hundred households, and further made Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of seven hundred households, and further made Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈司徒。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 景胤，初為成德軍中軍兵馬使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校太子賓客、監察御史。

translations.literal: Jingyin was at first Chengde central army cavalry commander, Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Crown Prince's Guest, and Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyin was at first Chengde central army cavalry commander, Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Crown Prince's Guest, and Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 紹鼎卒，出為深州刺史、兼殿中侍御史，充本州團練守捉使。

translations.literal: When Shaoding died he went out as Shen prefect and Concurrent Palace Attendant, regimental commander and defense commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoding died he went out as Shen prefect and Concurrent Palace Attendant, regimental commander and defense commissioner of that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景崇，於季父紹懿時為鎮州大都督府左司馬、知府事、都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Jingchong, during his uncle Shaoyi's time, was Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, and commander of all military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchong, during his uncle Shaoyi's time, was Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, and commander of all military affairs.

sentences.zh: 紹鼎卒，三軍立紹懿。

translations.literal: When Shaoding died the three armies established Shaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoding died the three armies established Shaoyi.

sentences.zh: 數月，疾篤。

translations.literal: Several months later he was gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later he was gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 召景崇謂之曰：「亡兄以軍政托予，以俟汝成立。

translations.literal: He summoned Jingchong and said to him: "My late brother entrusted military government to me to wait for you to mature.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Jingchong and said to him, "My late brother entrusted military government to me to wait for you to mature.

sentences.zh: 今危惙如此，殆將不救。

translations.literal: Now I am critically ill like this; I am probably beyond saving.
translations.idiomatic: Now I am critically ill like this. I am probably beyond saving.

sentences.zh: 汝雖少年，勉自負荷，下禮籓鄰，上奉朝旨，俾吾兄家業不墜，惟汝之才也！」

translations.literal: Though you are still young, strive to bear the burden yourself; treat neighboring circuits with courtesy below and serve court orders above, so that my brother's house and enterprise do not fall—only your talent can do it!"
translations.idiomatic: Though you are still young, strive to bear the burden yourself. Treat neighboring circuits with courtesy below and serve court orders above, so that my brother's house and enterprise do not fall—only your talent can do it!"

sentences.zh: 言訖而卒。

translations.literal: When he finished speaking he died.
translations.idiomatic: When he finished speaking he died.

sentences.zh: 時監軍在席，奏其治命，上嘉之，詔起復忠武將軍、守左金吾衛將軍同正、檢校右散騎常侍，充成德軍節度觀察留後，仍賜上柱國，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: At that time the supervisor was present; he reported this deathbed command; the emperor commended it; an edict recalled him from mourning as Loyal Martial General, Defender Left Golden Guard General of the same rank, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Chengde military observation acting commissioner, and also granted Pillar of State and the gold and purple fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the supervisor was present. He reported this deathbed command. The emperor commended it. An edict recalled him from mourning as Loyal Martial General, Defender Left Golden Guard General of the same rank, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Chengde military observation acting commissioner, and also granted Pillar of State and the gold and purple fish bag.

sentences.zh: 尋正授節度使、檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，景崇以公主嫡孫，特承恩渥。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong years Jingchong, as the princess's legitimate grandson, especially received imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong years Jingchong, as the princess's legitimate grandson, especially received imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 季年，盜起徐方，王師進討，景崇令大將從諸軍。

translations.literal: In his later years bandits rose in Xu region; the imperial army advanced in attack; Jingchong ordered great generals to follow the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years bandits rose in Xu region. The imperial army advanced in attack. Jingchong ordered great generals to follow the various armies.

sentences.zh: 徐寇平，以功授檢校右僕射，封太原縣男，食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: When the Xu rebels were pacified, for merit he was appointed Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xu rebels were pacified, for merit he was appointed Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 祖母章惠長公主薨，景崇居喪得禮，朝野稱之。

translations.literal: When his grandmother Princess Zhanghui died, Jingchong observed mourning with propriety; court and countryside praised it.
translations.idiomatic: When his grandmother Princess Zhanghui died, Jingchong observed mourning with propriety. Court and countryside praised it.

sentences.zh: 起復左金吾衛上將軍同正，進位檢校司空。

translations.literal: Recalled from mourning as Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank; promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled from mourning as Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank. Promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 明年，同中書門下平章事，累加檢校太尉、趙國公，食邑三千戶，食實封二百戶，尋進封常山王。

translations.literal: The next year Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery; repeatedly promoted to Acting Grand Marshal, Duke of Zhao with a fief of three thousand households and substantive fief of two hundred households; soon further enfeoffed as Prince of Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery. Repeatedly promoted to Acting Grand Marshal, Duke of Zhao with a fief of three thousand households and substantive fief of two hundred households. Soon further enfeoffed as Prince of Changshan.

sentences.zh: 丁母秦國夫人憂，起復本官。

translations.literal: Upon his mother Lady of Qin's mourning he was recalled to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his mother Lady of Qin's mourning he was recalled to his original office.

sentences.zh: 乾符末，盜起河南，黃巢犯闕，駕幸劍南；

translations.literal: At the end of Qianfu bandits rose in Henan; Huang Chao violated the capital; the carriage fled to Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Qianfu bandits rose in Henan. Huang Chao violated the capital. The carriage fled to Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 景崇與定州節度使王處存馳檄籓鄰，以兵附處存入關討賊，奔問行在，貢輸相繼。

translations.literal: Jingchong with Ding Prefecture military commissioner Wang Chucun urgently dispatched proclamations to neighboring circuits, attached troops to Chucun and entered the passes to attack bandits, hurried to the traveling palace, and tribute followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchong with Ding Prefecture military commissioner Wang Chucun urgently dispatched proclamations to neighboring circuits, attached troops to Chucun and entered the passes to attack bandits, hurried to the traveling palace, and tribute followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 關輔平定，以功真拜太尉。

translations.literal: When Guanzhong was pacified, for merit he was formally appointed Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: When Guanzhong was pacified, for merit he was formally appointed Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 中和二年十二月卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Zhonghe he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Zhonghe he died.

sentences.zh: 子镕，時年十歲，三軍推為留後，朝廷因授旄鉞，檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: His son Rong was then ten years old; the three armies pushed him as acting commissioner; the court thereupon granted the banner and baton and appointed him Acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His son Rong was then ten years old. The three armies pushed him as acting commissioner. The court thereupon granted the banner and baton and appointed him Acting Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 時天子蒙塵，九州鼎沸，河東節度李克用虎視山東，方謀吞據；

translations.literal: At that time the Son of Heaven was in distress; the nine provinces seethed; Hedong military commissioner Li Keyong glared at the east of the mountains and plotted to swallow and hold.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Son of Heaven was in distress. The nine provinces seethed. Hedong military commissioner Li Keyong glared at the east of the mountains and plotted to swallow and hold.

sentences.zh: 镕以重賂結納，以修和好。

translations.literal: Rong with heavy bribes formed ties and cultivated good relations.
translations.idiomatic: Rong with heavy bribes formed ties and cultivated good relations.

sentences.zh: 晉軍討孟方立於邢州，镕常奉以芻糧。

translations.literal: When the Jin army attacked Meng Fangli at Xing Prefecture, Rong regularly supplied him with fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin army attacked Meng Fangli at Xing Prefecture, Rong regularly supplied him with fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 及方立平，晉將李存孝侵镕南部，镕求援於幽州。

translations.literal: When Fangli was pacified, Jin general Li Cunxiao invaded Rong's southern territory; Rong sought aid from Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Fangli was pacified, Jin general Li Cunxiao invaded Rong's southern territory. Rong sought aid from Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 幽帥李匡威率眾三萬赴之，存孝退去。

translations.literal: Youzhou commander Li Kuangwei led thirty thousand men to the rescue; Cunxiao withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou commander Li Kuangwei led thirty thousand men to the rescue. Cunxiao withdrew.

sentences.zh: 景福元年，镕乘存孝有間於其師，乃出兵攻堯山。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingfu, Rong taking advantage of Cunxiao's breach with his commander then sent troops to attack Yaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingfu, Rong taking advantage of Cunxiao's breach with his commander then sent troops to attack Yaoshan.

sentences.zh: 晉帥遣大將李存質來援，大敗鎮人於堯山，死者萬計。

translations.literal: The Jin commander sent the great general Li Cunzhi to aid; he heavily defeated the Zhen men at Yaoshan; the dead numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin commander sent the great general Li Cunzhi to aid. He heavily defeated the Zhen men at Yaoshan. The dead numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 晉人乘勝至趙州，镕復求援於燕。

translations.literal: The Jin men pressed the victory to Zhao Prefecture; Rong again sought aid from Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin men pressed the victory to Zhao Prefecture. Rong again sought aid from Yan.

sentences.zh: 二年，匡威率眾數萬來援。

translations.literal: In the second year Kuangwei led tens of thousands to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Kuangwei led tens of thousands to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 會邢州節度使李存孝背其帥據城自固，存孝單騎入鎮州，與镕面相盟約。

translations.literal: When Xing Prefecture military commissioner Li Cunxiao turned against his commander, held the city and fortified himself, Cunxiao rode alone into Zhen Prefecture and with Rong faced one another and pledged alliance.
translations.idiomatic: When Xing Prefecture military commissioner Li Cunxiao turned against his commander, held the city and fortified himself, Cunxiao rode alone into Zhen Prefecture and with Rong faced one another and pledged alliance.

sentences.zh: 俄而李克用自率全師攻存孝，時匡威離鎮後，其弟匡籌奪據其位，匡威退無歸路。

translations.literal: Soon Li Keyong personally led the full army to attack Cunxiao; at that time after Kuangwei left his post his younger brother Kuangchou seized his position; Kuangwei retreated with no road of return.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Keyong personally led the full army to attack Cunxiao. At that time after Kuangwei left his post his younger brother Kuangchou seized his position. Kuangwei retreated with no road of return.

sentences.zh: 镕感其援助之恩，乃迎入府城，築第以居之，事之如父；

translations.literal: Rong, moved by his aid, welcomed him into headquarters, built a residence for him to dwell in, and served him like a father.
translations.idiomatic: Rong, moved by his aid, welcomed him into headquarters, built a residence for him to dwell in, and served him like a father.

sentences.zh: 匡威亦盡心裨益，軍中之事，皆為訓練。

translations.literal: Kuangwei also gave his whole heart in support; military affairs were all trained by him.
translations.idiomatic: Kuangwei also gave his whole heart in support. Military affairs were all trained by him.

sentences.zh: 是年五月，镕過匡威第，陰遣部下伏甲劫镕；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year Rong passed Kuangwei's residence and secretly sent subordinates with hidden armor to seize Rong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year Rong passed Kuangwei's residence and secretly sent subordinates with hidden armor to seize Rong.

sentences.zh: 镕抱持之，镕曰：「公誡止人勿倉卒！

translations.literal: Rong embraced and held him; Rong said: "My lord, warn your men not to act in haste!
translations.idiomatic: Rong embraced and held him. Rong said, "My lord, warn your men not to act in haste!

sentences.zh: 吾為晉人所困，賴公獲濟，猶吾父也，軍政請公帥之。」

translations.literal: I was trapped by the Jin men and relied on you to be saved—you are still like my father; military government I ask you to command."
translations.idiomatic: I was trapped by the Jin men and relied on you to be saved—you are still like my father. Military government I ask you to command."

sentences.zh: 即並轡歸府署，鎮軍拒之，竟殺匡威。

translations.literal: They then rode side by side back to headquarters; the Zhen army resisted; in the end Kuangwei was killed.
translations.idiomatic: They then rode side by side back to headquarters. The Zhen army resisted. In the end Kuangwei was killed.

sentences.zh: 晉人知匡威死，克用自率師至城下；

translations.literal: When the Jin men learned Kuangwei was dead, Keyong personally led troops to below the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin men learned Kuangwei was dead, Keyong personally led troops to below the city wall.

sentences.zh: 镕出練二十萬犒勞，修好而退。

translations.literal: Rong brought out two hundred thousand in white silk to reward the army and made peace and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Rong brought out two hundred thousand in white silk to reward the army and made peace and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 及汴宋節度使硃全忠領鄆、青三鎮，兵強天下，遣將葛從周、張存敬寇陷邢、洺二州，乘勝北掠燕、趙。

translations.literal: When Bian-Song military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong held Yan and Qing circuits and three commands, his troops were strongest in the realm; he sent generals Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing to raid and take Xing and Ming prefectures and, pressing the victory, raided north through Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: When Bian-Song military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong held Yan and Qing circuits and three commands, his troops were strongest in the realm. He sent generals Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing to raid and take Xing and Ming prefectures and, pressing the victory, raided north through Yan and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 俄而全忠率親兵薄於城下。

translations.literal: Soon Quanzhong led personal troops close below the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Quanzhong led personal troops close below the city wall.

sentences.zh: 镕倉卒無備，謂賓佐曰：「勢危矣，計將安出？」

translations.literal: Rong in haste was unprepared and said to his staff: "The situation is critical—what plan shall we use?"
translations.idiomatic: Rong in haste was unprepared and said to his staff, "The situation is critical—what plan shall we use?"

sentences.zh: 判官周式者，率先而對曰：「敵人迫我，兵不能抗，此可以理說耳，請見梁帥圖之！」

translations.literal: Judge Zhou Shi was first to reply: "The enemy presses us; troops cannot resist—this can be addressed with reason; please let me see the Liang commander and plan it!"
translations.idiomatic: Judge Zhou Shi was first to reply, "The enemy presses us. Troops cannot resist—this can be addressed with reason. Please let me see the Liang commander and plan it!"

sentences.zh: 式即時出見全忠，全忠逆謂式曰：「爾不必言。

translations.literal: Shi immediately went out to see Quanzhong; Quanzhong met him and said: "You need not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Shi immediately went out to see Quanzhong. Quanzhong met him and said, "You need not speak.

sentences.zh: 王令朋附並汾，違盟爽信，敝賦業已及此，期於無舍！」

translations.literal: Lord Wang ordered attachment to Bing and Fen, broke alliance and faith; my army has already reached here—I expect no sparing!"
translations.idiomatic: Lord Wang ordered attachment to Bing and Fen, broke alliance and faith. My army has already reached here—I expect no sparing!"

sentences.zh: 式曰：「公言過矣！

translations.literal: Shi said: "My lord speaks too far!
translations.idiomatic: Shi said, "My lord speaks too far!

sentences.zh: 且公為唐室之桓、文，當以禮義而成霸業。

translations.literal: Moreover you are the Tang dynasty's Duke Huan and Duke Wen—you should with ritual and righteousness complete hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover you are the Tang dynasty's Duke Huan and Duke Wen—you should with ritual and righteousness complete hegemony.

sentences.zh: 乃欲窮兵黷武，困人於險難，天下其謂公何！」

translations.literal: Yet you wish to exhaust troops and drown men in hardship—what will the realm say of you!"
translations.idiomatic: Yet you wish to exhaust troops and drown men in hardship—what will the realm say of you!"

sentences.zh: 全忠喜，引式袂而慰之曰：「前言戲之耳！

translations.literal: Quanzhong was pleased, took Shi's sleeve and comforted him: "Earlier words were in jest!
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong was pleased, took Shi's sleeve and comforted him, "Earlier words were in jest!

sentences.zh: 且君為王令計如何？」

translations.literal: Moreover what plan do you have for Lord Wang?"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover what plan do you have for Lord Wang?"

sentences.zh: 式曰：「但修好耳！」

translations.literal: Shi said: "Only make peace!"
translations.idiomatic: Shi said, "Only make peace!"

sentences.zh: 即復見镕，請出牛酒貨幣以犒軍；

translations.literal: He then again saw Rong and asked to bring out oxen, wine, goods, and currency to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: He then again saw Rong and asked to bring out oxen, wine, goods, and currency to reward the army.

sentences.zh: 仍以镕子昭祚及牙將梁公儒、李弘規子各一人，從昭祚入官於大梁，全忠以女妻昭祚。

translations.literal: Also Rong's son Zhaozuo and yamen generals Liang Gongru and Li Honggui's sons each one person followed Zhaozuo to serve at court in Daliang; Quanzhong gave his daughter in marriage to Zhaozuo.
translations.idiomatic: Also Rong's son Zhaozuo and yamen generals Liang Gongru and Li Honggui's sons each one person followed Zhaozuo to serve at court in Daliang. Quanzhong gave his daughter in marriage to Zhaozuo.

sentences.zh: 及全忠僭，天下無主；

translations.literal: When Quanzhong usurped, the realm had no lord.
translations.idiomatic: When Quanzhong usurped, the realm had no lord.

sentences.zh: 镕不獲已，行其正朔。

translations.literal: Rong had no choice but to observe his calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Rong had no choice but to observe his calendar.

sentences.zh: 镕累遷至開府儀同三司，守太師、中書令，仍賜「敦睦保定大功臣」、上柱國、趙王，食邑一萬五千戶，食實封一千戶，襲食實封二百五十戶。

translations.literal: Rong was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with privilege to open an office, Defender Grand Preceptor, Director of the Chancellery, and was also granted "Great Meritorious Minister of Harmonious Assurance," Pillar of State, Prince of Zhao, fief of fifteen thousand households, substantive fief of one thousand households, and inherited substantive fief of two hundred fifty households.
translations.idiomatic: Rong was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with privilege to open an office, Defender Grand Preceptor, Director of the Chancellery, and was also granted "Great Meritorious Minister of Harmonious Assurance," Pillar of State, Prince of Zhao, fief of fifteen thousand households, substantive fief of one thousand households, and inherited substantive fief of two hundred fifty households.

sentences.zh: 偽梁加尚書令，及唐室中興，去偽尚書令之號。

translations.literal: False Liang added Director of the Department of State Affairs; when the Tang dynasty revived, the false Director of the Department of State Affairs title was removed.
translations.idiomatic: False Liang added Director of the Department of State Affairs. When the Tang dynasty revived, the false Director of the Department of State Affairs title was removed.

sentences.zh: 天祐七年，母魏國太夫人何氏卒，起復本官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianyou his mother Grand Lady of Wei, Lady He, died; he was recalled to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianyou his mother Grand Lady of Wei, Lady He, died. He was recalled to his original office.

sentences.zh: 十八年，為其大將王德明所殺，至於赤族。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was killed by his great general Wang Deming, down to extermination of the clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was killed by his great general Wang Deming, down to extermination of the clan.

sentences.zh: 其後事在中興云。

translations.literal: Later affairs are in the Restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Later affairs are in the Restoration.

sentences.zh: 贊=史臣曰：土運中微，群盜孔熾。

translations.literal: Comment: The historians say: Earth's fortune declined in the middle; bandits were greatly rampant.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: The historians say: Earth's fortune declined in the middle; bandits were greatly rampant.

sentences.zh: 寶臣附麗安、史，流毒中原，終竊土疆，為國蟊賊。

translations.literal: Baochen attached to An and Shi, spread poison through the central plains, and in the end stole territory and became a plague to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen attached to An and Shi, spread poison through the central plains, and in the end stole territory and became a plague to the state.

sentences.zh: 加以武俊之狠狡，為其腹心，或叛或臣，見利忘義，蛇吞蝮吐，垂二百年。

translations.literal: Add Wujun's fierce cunning as his inner heart—now rebel, now minister, forgetting righteousness for profit, snake swallowing and viper spitting—for nearly two hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Add Wujun's fierce cunning as his inner heart—now rebel, now minister, forgetting righteousness for profit, snake swallowing and viper spitting—for nearly two hundred years.

sentences.zh: 哀哉，王政不綱，以至於此。

translations.literal: Alas, royal government lacked discipline, until it came to this.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, royal government lacked discipline, until it came to this.

sentences.zh: 若使明皇不懈於開元之政，姚崇久握於阿衡，詎有柳城一胡，敢窺佐伯，況其下者哉！

translations.literal: If Emperor Ming had not slackened Kaiyuan government and Yao Chong long held the balance—how could a single Hu of Liucheng dare gaze at the chief minister, how much less those below!
translations.idiomatic: If Emperor Ming had not slackened Kaiyuan government and Yao Chong long held the balance—how could a single Hu of Liucheng dare gaze at the chief minister, how much less those below!

sentences.zh: 觀此無君，可為太息。

translations.literal: Seeing this lack of lord, one can only sigh deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing this lack of lord, one can only sigh deeply.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：鵂鹠為怪，必取其昏。

translations.literal: Praise says: When the owl demon acts strange, it must take the confused.
translations.idiomatic: Praise says: When the owl demon acts strange, it must take the confused.

sentences.zh: 人君失政，為盜啟門。

translations.literal: When the ruler loses government, he opens the door to bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the ruler loses government, he opens the door to bandits.

sentences.zh: 牙旂金鉞，虎子狼孫。

translations.literal: Banner staffs and golden axes—tiger sons and wolf grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Banner staffs and golden axes—tiger sons and wolf grandsons.

sentences.zh: 茫茫黔首，於何叫閽？

translations.literal: The boundless black-haired people—to whom shall they cry at the gate?
translations.idiomatic: The boundless black-haired people—to whom shall they cry at the gate?
